data.name: 1st Sorrow: Distance Dies First
data.description:
You teleport behind the target and make a Heavy attack against them.

If you would be isolated after the teleport, the range increased to 120ft.
data.requirement: Must be in Lone Wolf Stance. Must be made with a Katana, Heavy Blade, Scythe, Chainsaw or Small Weapon.

data.name: 2nd Sorrow: One Against The World
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against all enemies in range.
data.requirement: Must be in Lone Wolf Stance and must be Isolated. Must be made with a Katana, Heavy Blade, Scythe, Chainsaw or Small Weapon.

data.name: 3rd Sorrow: Blade Without Witness
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target.

If you are Isolated, reduce the mana cost of this by 1.
data.requirement: Must be in Lone Wolf Stance. Must be made with a Katana, Heavy Blade, Scythe, Chainsaw or Small Weapon.

data.name: Abjurer's Blast
data.description: You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the target that deals Arcane damage.

data.name: Absorb Ice
data.description:
You gain Absorb Ice, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 Frost against the triggering damage. After the damage resolves, if the caster is not you, someone allied to you or from an effect made by you or an ally, you gain Temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to the amount of damage this ability reduces.

Any on hit effects from the damage do not apply if you took 0 damage from it because of your DR.

data.name: Accelerando
data.description: Grant yourself or an ally +4 initiative.

data.name: Accelerating Strike
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target. Afterwards, you gain Accelerating Strike, which increases your Initiative by up to 2.

data.name: Adaptive Defense
data.description: You take the Block Action. You then gain 4 Adaptive Defense (Type) which grants you Damage Reduction 4 against that damage type until the end of your next turn. You can only have one instance of Adaptive Defense at a time.

data.name: Advanced Artificing
data.description:
Artifice Modification B
Cost: X crafting points
Description: 
You add a B-Type modification to an artifice. See the Universal Artifice mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Weapon Modification B
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an B-Type modification to the weapon. See the Universal Weapon page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

data.name: Aerial Crashdown
data.description: You and your mount crash down on the target. You move towards the target and your mount makes a Heavy attack against it. On damage, the target is knocked prone.
data.requirement: You are mounted on a flying mount and the target is at least 20ft below you.

data.name: Aerial Loop
data.description: You and your mount take the Dodge action and gain a +5 bonus to evasion against the attack.
data.requirement: You are mounted on a flying mount and you or your mount are the target of a ranged attack

data.name: Aerial Mode Switch
data.description:
You switch between hover and aerial mode.

Hover mode allows you to attack with normal attacks with one hand. Your airships movement speed is reduced to 10ft while in hover mode. 

While in Aerial Mode you cannot use any attacks or actions that are not airship weapons or have the Aerial Mage keyword.

data.name: Aftershock
data.description:
You attack with such force that you create aftershocks when you miss your attack, dealing Half Pierce Physical Damage equal to your Power to the target and all enemies within 5ft of it. 

If the target Dodged the triggering attack, this damage is reduced to half your Power instead.

If your attack targets multiple enemies, this only applies if you miss all enemies.
data.requirement: You missed a Heavy melee attack with a Two-Handed Melee Weapon.

data.name: Aimed Shot
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.

data.name: Airheart Gravity Turn
data.description: You drop 25 feet altitude in order to immediately change direction. Can be used mid movement, all leftover movement can carry over into the new direction.
data.requirement: Must be at least 30ft in the sky and on an aerial staff in Aerial mode

data.name: Alarm Ward
data.description: A ward that can be placed on a normal-sized room or can be combined to ward off a house or larger area. Each ward can cover a 40ft radius. For each Alarm Ward placed in the same area as another Alarm Ward, this radius increases by 40ft (For example, 120ft with 3 Alarm Wards). If someone other than you passes through the ward, the ward triggers creating a loud ringing noise that persists until the ward is disabled. Casting this takes 10 minutes of uninterrupted casting. Once triggered, the field remains active for 5 more minutes before vanishing. At the time of casting, you may choose people that can pass through the barrier without triggering it. If not triggered, Alarm Ward lasts until you remove it. For each Alarm Ward you maintain, your maximum mana is reduced by 1. This is considered a tier 1 ward.

data.name: Alchemeister Core Crafting
data.description:
Masterful Dilution
Cost: 40 Crafting Points
Description: 
By diluting the contents to the perfect required amounts, you gain an additional Elixir, Potion, Flask, Potion or Salve upon crafting success. Stacks with Efficient Dilution.

Distillation
Cost: 40 Crafting Points
Description: 
You extract the highest quality healing materials from herbs, granting Healing +8 to a Potion with a heal or shielding effect.

Explosive Lining
Cost: 10 Crafting Points
Description: 
You carefully add an alchemical compound to a pressurized Flask. If the Flask has an area of effect, increases the area by another 5ft (example a 10ft radius becomes 15ft radius).

Purify Elixir
Cost: 40 Crafting Points
Description: 
You reduce the toxicity of an Elixir that has been detoxified while still maintaining its effect, reducing the damage from taking an Elixir by an additional 5.

data.name: Alchemical Detonation
data.description: You touch a wall, door or container in front of you, which shatters from deconstructive force, becoming destroyed.  Can destroy up to a 5ftx5ft segment of wall.  Only affects objects made out of common building materials (wood, clay, stone, iron etc), however it affects all walls made out of player abilities.  The GM determines if the object is detonateable.  You can then take a movement action to move 5ft into the space where the wall was.

data.name: Alchemist Core Crafting
data.description:
Efficient Dilution
Cost: 10 Crafting Points
Description: 
By diluting the contents to the perfect required amounts, you gain an additional Elixir, Potion, Flask, Poison or Salve upon crafting success.

Stone Grinding
Cost: 10 Crafting Points
Description: 
You extract the highest quality healing materials from herbs, granting Healing +5 to a Potion with a heal or shielding effect.

Pressurization 
Cost: 10 Crafting Points
Description: 
You pressurize a Flask carefully. If the Flask has an area of effect, increases the area by 5ft (example a 10ft radius becomes 15ft radius).

Volatile Flask
Cost: 10 Crafting Points
Description: 
You overload the active ingredients on a Flask, giving it a +5 damage to its damaging effects.

Detoxify Elixir
Cost: 10 Crafting Points
Description: 
You reduce the toxicity of an Elixir while still maintaining its effect, reducing the damage from taking an Elixir by 3.

Create Oil Coating
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create an Oil Coating from Carpenter materials.  See Items:  Carpenter Materials

data.name: Allow me to clean that~
data.description:
You instantly remove a negative effect from the terrain (such as Oil Slick, Sheet Ice, Web etc). Permanent effects such as fissure or effects with HP like a wall cannot be removed with this. A maximum of 15x15ft can be removed in 1 use and you may move to any spot of the cleaned terrain afterwards.

In addition, you may target an ally with this to remove 1 negative physical effect from them instead.

data.name: Always Prepared
data.description:
You immediately purchase a single base item with no mods that is worth 1000 clim or less (base cost). 

You can immediately use the draw/stow action and equip this item into your hand. 

Can only be used once per arc.

data.name: Ambush Trapper
data.description:
You may use Place Trap’s 0 RP effect once this encounter, even if you didn’t spend the time to set it up. The GM may rule that the pitfall and net options are unavailable based on the situation.

These activations still cost a Trap when used (but not if you don't use them).
data.requirement: Must be stealthed or have surprised the enemy.

data.name: Amoxicillin
data.description: You choose up to 10 willing units in range.  After spending 1 minute in concentration, you create a cloud of spores that heals a disease that you can identify.

data.name: Amphibious
data.description: You can swim up to your speed and can hold your breath underwater for up to an hour.

data.name: Anathema
data.description: You choose one target unit and they must save against your Potency or be afflicted by Anathema. Anathema increases the next source of damage that the target receives by your Heavy Attack damage.

data.name: Angel's Embrace
data.description: You grant the target ally Angel’s Embrace, which grants a Shield against the triggering attack that blocks damage equal to 5 + (2 x Toughness).
data.requirement: A creature other than you is attacked.

data.name: Antennae
data.description: You are able to detect creatures by sensing the vibrations in the air. You gain a +10 expertise bonus to Perception (Vibration Sense) which works up to 40ft from you, but only detects creatures.

data.name: Anti-Magic Shield
data.description: You grant the target ally 1 RP that must be spend on a basic Dodge or Block action against the triggering attack as well as Anti-Magic Shield for the triggering attack. Anti-Magic Shield reduces the damage the target ally takes by your Focus.
data.requirement: Ally is the target of a damage dealing Spell.

data.name: Anti-Shield
data.description: You weave a web of magic around the target. The target cannot be the target of any abilities with the Shield keyword until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Anvil Tactics
data.description: A single ally in range may move up to their speed. If they end up in melee range of an enemy and there is an ally on the direct opposite side of that enemy, they may make an Attack of Opportunity. This attack gains Lock On.

data.name: Aqua Drill
data.description:
You infuse water with your mana firing a spiraling blast of high pressure water, making a heavy attack that deals Water damage against a target within range. You can use either the RP or AP cost for the ability.  The water is used as a projectile and spills anywhere within 5ft of the target at your choice.

If you use an RP for this ability, the mana cost increases by 1.
data.requirement: You are touching an amount of water equal to a normal sized bucket of water.

data.name: Aquatic Fae
data.description:
While swimming, your base movement speed becomes 30.

Your Aqua Drill costs 0 mana when used as RP ability while in natural water.

data.name: Arcane Barrier
data.description:
You create a Magical Barrier that absorbs damage until it breaks. The barrier has HP equal to 15 + your Focus. The barrier has a Guard of 0 and any damage it takes is subtracted from the barrier’s HP. When the barrier breaks, any remaining damage is subtracted from your HP. The barrier otherwise lasts until the start of your next turn or until you take any action other than the Block action.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity and does not protect against true damage.

data.name: Arcane Barrier II
data.description:
You create a Magical Barrier that absorbs damage until it breaks. 

The barrier has HP equal to 15 + your Focus. The barrier has a Guard of 0 + your guard and any damage it takes is subtracted from the barrier’s HP. When the barrier breaks, any remaining damage is subtracted from your HP. The barrier otherwise lasts until the start of your next turn or until you take any action other than the Block action. If using the Block action while the barrier is active, the guard of the barrier also increases. 

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity and does not protect against true damage.

data.name: Arcane Blast
data.description: You make a Heavy attack that deals Arcane damage against the target.

data.name: Arcane Buster
data.description: You fire a blast of energy, making a Heavy Attack that deals Arcane Damage. This attack has the Shieldbreaker property.

data.name: Arcane Explosion
data.description: You make a Light Attack that deals Arcane damage against all enemies within range.

data.name: Arcane Power
data.description: You gain Arcane Power, which adds 3 damage to the damage of all your Arcane Damage rolls until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Arcane Pull
data.description: You pull the target to an empty square next to you. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Your next Block or Dodge action against the target before the start of your next turn costs 0 RP. This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
data.requirement: Target is challenged by you and attacking someone that isn't you.

data.name: Arcane Rapidfire
data.description: You make 4 light attacks that deal Arcane damage against the target.

data.name: Armor Crushing Shell
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you apply Sunder 2 until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Armor Up
data.description: You gain temporary HP equal to the Block value of your armor and shield, up to a maximum of 40 temporary HP.
data.requirement: Must be wearing armor and/or a shield.

data.name: Armored Blow
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. Your next Block against that target costs 0 RP and gains a +10 bonus.
data.requirement: May only be used after moving at least 20ft in the previous action. Must be mounted.

data.name: Armorsmith Basics
data.description:
Armorsmith's Modification A
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an A-Type modification to the armor. See the Universal Armor page as well as the individual armor pages for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Armorsmith's Modification Frame
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an Frame-Type modification to the armor. See the Universal Armor page as well as the individual armor pages for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Adaptive Layering
Cost: X crafting points
Description: 
You mix a special material into the armor or shield. Each material has its own crafting point cost.

Cloak Layering
Cost: X crafting points
Description: 
You use a special material for the creation of the cloak. Each material has its own crafting point cost. Only cloak special materials can be used and mixing in a special material increases the burden cost of the cloak by 1.

Create Ingot
Cost: Errand
Description: 
You create an ingot from armorsmithing base materials or from armorsmithing special materials.  See Item: Armorsmithing Materials.

Tan Leather
Cost: Errand
Description: 
You create a tanned hide from armorsmithing base leather materials. See item: Armorsmithing materials.

data.name: Armorsmithing Expert
data.description:
Armorsmith's Modification B
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an B-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Armor page as well as the individual armor pages for details. Each modification has its own cost.

data.name: Artery Cut
data.description: You change the arc of your weapon and go for a vital spot, turning the hit into a critical hit.
data.requirement: One-Handed weapon only, can be used after a light attack hits and is not reacted against.

data.name: Artificer Basics
data.description:
Artifice Modification A
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an A-Type modification to an artifice. See the Universal Artifice mods page as well as the individual artifice page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Weapon Modification A
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an A-Type modification to the weapon. See the Universal Weapon mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Artifice Modification C
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an C-Type modification to the weapon. See the Universal Artifice mods page as well as the individual artifice page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Craft Fuel Shells
Cost: Errand
Description: 
You craft up to 5 small shells.  You can instead craft a medium shell instead of 2 small shells.  Small shells require 50 magical fuel, medium shells require 200 magical fuel.

Craft Artifice Parts
Cost: Errand
Description: 
You create up to 3000u of artifice parts of the same type of blacksmithing material used to make them at a 1:1 rate. (3000u of Iron Creates 3000u of Iron Artifice Parts.)  See Items:  Blacksmithing Materials, Artificer Materials. When converting items of a higher tier, you can convert up to 6000 of tamahagane, 9000 of mithril, 12000 of Orihalcum or 15000 of escudo.

Firearm Alloy
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You mix a special material into the firearm or artifice weapon. Each material has its own crafting point cost.

Create Ingot
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create an ingot from blacksmithing base materials or from blacksmithing special materials.  See Item: Blacksmithing Materials.

data.name: Assign Decoy
data.description: Choose one willing ally other than yourself within range and one enemy within range. The enemy is Challenged by the chosen ally until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Astral Projection
data.description: After a 10 minute channel you arrive at the space between worlds, allowing you to interact with Eidolons that wish to meet with you.

data.name: At your side
data.description: You teleport up to 40ft. This must place you next to your VIP.

data.name: Attack in Detail
data.description: You target one enemy unit. All allied units (including yourself) gain a +1 Damage Bonus when that enemy unit is the target of an attack until the start of your next turn. In addition, all allied units gain +5 Movement Speed when moving towards that enemy unit.

data.name: Attacks from the Past
data.description:
After making a melee weapon attack, you may repeat the attack from one of your past self tokens. You may target the same enemy as your original attack. Cannot repeat Secret Arts or other attacks with a once per combat/arc etc type limitation.

Can only repeat attacks with a base cost of 2 AP or lower and any mana cost must be paid as normal.

data.name: Attune Eidolon
data.description:
You attune to a specific Eidolon, paying the attunement cost (if applicable) and then activating its Passive (if applicable).  You gain its Channel Eidolon, Summon Lesser Eidolon and Secret Art: Summon Eidolon abilities provided that you have advanced enough in this class to get them.

You may use this as an Encounter Start ability without paying an AP cost.
data.requirement: You have an Eidolon you are contracted to.

data.name: Aura of Protection
data.description: You create a 30ft radius Aura of Protection around yourself. While this aura is active, when an ally within 30ft of you takes the Block action you may spend 1 Mana to replace their Block Value with your own. In addition, any abilities with the Aid keyword have their range increased by 20ft while inside the Aura.

data.name: Aura of Resistance
data.description:
You create a 30ft radius Aura of Resistance around yourself until the end of the encounter. 

While this aura is active, when an ally other than yourself fails a save you may spend 1 Mana to make them treat their save as if they were using your Toughness value instead of their own.

name: Aurora Blade Style Secret Art: Permafrost Guilotine

data.name: Aurora Blade Style Secret Art: Permafrost Guilotine
data.description:
You make a light attack against the target or spend 1 extra AP to make a heavy or precise attack that deals Frost damage. On damage, the target is rooted until the end of your next turn.

Then, enter Permafrost Guillotine stance. While in this stance you can use Aurora Blade Style Secret Art: Permafrost Guillotine again. The stance lasts until the end of combat or until you enter different stance.
data.requirement: Can only be used after you move to a target using Rimestep. Light swords, longsword, katana or dueling weapon only.

data.name: Aurora Blade Style: Aurora Slash
data.description:
You fire slashes in a straight line creating a curtain of light which strikes the first target hit with a light attack that deals frost damage. On hit the target is slowed until the end of your next turn. 

The light from the slash continues for the full range, creating a 300ft high wall that blocks vision on both sides. This wall of multicolored light last until the end of your next turn.
data.requirement: Light swords, longsword, katana or dueling weapon only.

data.name: Aurora Blade Style: Rimestep
data.description: When a target is slowed by an attack with the frost keyword, you may sidestep up to your speed towards the target. If you have enough movement you can end your movement anywhere next to the target. Overcharge: You may spend 1 Mana to instead make it three times your speed.

data.name: Aurora Blade Style: Winter's Edge
data.description: You imbue your blade with frost energy and make a precise attack that deals Frost damage. On hit, the target is slowed until the end of your next turn.
data.requirement: Light swords, longsword, katana or dueling weapon only.

data.name: Ave María
data.description: You attack with a swift double slash in the blink of an eye, making a Heavy Attack that deals Light damage + Heavy Holy damage.

data.name: Backlash
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target. You take true damage equal to half the damage dealt.

data.name: Banana Peel
data.description: You toss a banana peel in front of the target and they must make a Save or fall prone. If they fall prone, you may immediately use Pie Toss against them for 0 RP.

data.name: Barrel Roll
data.description:
You take the Dodge action and remove Lock On from the attack.

You may spend an additional RP to automatically make the attack miss you, even if the attack has Sure Hit.
data.requirement: You are on an aerial staff and in Aerial mode.

data.name: Battle Cast
data.description: The next Spell you cast before the end of your turn does not provoke an attack of opportunity from being casted in Melee Range of an opponent.

data.name: Bear Maul
data.description:
You swing your paw at the target and make a Heavy attack against it that deals maximum damage. If the target dodges, this attack automatically misses.

You are considered proficient in unarmed attacks for this attack, even if you normally wouldn’t be.

data.name: Bear Shock
data.description: You gain a +20 bonus to Deception checks when disguising yourself as something other than a bearfolk.

data.name: Bear Trap
data.description:
You place down a bear trap in an empty square within range. If an enemy enters that square, they trigger the trap taking Light full pierce damage and becoming rooted until they spend 2 AP to remove the effect.

Against beasts, this does Heavy damage instead of Light damage.

This ability consumes a Trap.

data.name: Benediction
data.description:
You make a precise attack against the target that deals Holy damage. On damage, inflict Sanctify 3.

This attack does not benefit from Pinpoint.

data.name: Bestial Command
data.description:
The summon may take basic actions as if it had 2 AP to spend.

In addition, if your summon is under the effects of Independent Action, it gains Bestial Command until the end of the encounter, it dies or you cancel it for 0 AP. While Bestial Command lasts, its maximum AP and AP recovery are increased by 2 while your AP recovery is lowered by 2.

data.name: Biohacking
data.description:
At the start of an arc, you can transmute a gene from a Chimera Subrace into your DNA as long as you have a sample (a vial of blood).

Transmuting the gene does not consume the item. Add a single Chimera gene to your gene inventory. 

You can perform this action again for an IP or EP. Biohacking can store genes equal to your gene limit.

data.name: Blackbird
data.description:
You deploy a Blackbird, a small artifice drone that outputs a grainy image to a device on your wrist.  The blackbird has a maximum range of 3000ft and can observe major movements and structures such as doors and enemies.  The drone cannot display fine movements or detail such as words in a book without being up close, but can see large signs.  The blackbird is the size of a walnut and is relatively quiet, and can only be heard by those with normal human hearing within 10 ft.

The fuel shell lasts for one flight, up to 15 minutes.  If your Blackbird is lost or damaged, you must create a new one as an errand action before you can use this again.

data.name: Blacksmith Core Crafting
data.description:
Blacksmith’s Modification A
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an A-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon or Crafting mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Weapon Alloy
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You mix a special material into the smithing weapon. Each material has its own crafting point cost.

Create Ingot
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create an ingot from blacksmithing base materials or from blacksmithing special materials.  See Item: Blacksmithing Materials.

data.name: Blast Away
data.description: You fire a point blank shot at an enemy unit. The enemy must save against your Potency or be knocked back 5ft and take Light Damage. This ability does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

data.name: Blast Wave
data.description: You may make a Light attack that deals Fire damage against every character within 10ft of you. On damage, they are pushed back 10ft. This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

data.name: Blinding Dust
data.description: You flap your wings and blow dust in the eyes of the attacker, making them Blinded 6 until the end of their attack. If their attack against you misses, you may Sidestep 5ft.
data.requirement: You are the target of an attack.

data.name: Blocking Move
data.description:
You move in front of the target and their movement action immediately ends. Until the end of their turn, they are Challenged by you and your next Block action against them costs 0 RP. If they willingly move from you through any method (including teleports) you may make a Heavy attack against them with Sure Hit.

Your movement may ignore Line Movement restrictions for this ability.
data.requirement: You made an opportunity attack against a target moving away from you. Must be mounted.

data.name: Blood Drain
data.description: You make a Light Attack that deals Dark damage against the target. On damage, you recover HP equal to your Toughness + 3.
data.requirement: Target must be a living creature. Target cannot be an ally.

data.name: Blood Frenzy
data.description:
You go into a blood frenzy, mindlessly attacking enemies near you.

While the blood frenzy lasts, you must attack the nearest enemy target with a basic unarmed attack. If two targets are equally close, you may choose which one you attack. If no enemies are within range, you must use your movement to move closer to the closest visible enemy until you can attack them.

While under the effect of blood frenzy, you heal for half the damage you deal with your unarmed attacks.

You cannot use Vampire Bite while under the effect of Blood Frenzy.

This effect lasts until all visible enemies are dead or until your mana runs out. At the start of your turn, you lose 2 mana.

data.name: Blood Shield
data.description: You grant the target 1 RP that must be spent on the Block action against the triggering attack. They gain a +5 bonus to their Guard for this Block action. After the attack, the target regains HP equal to half the damage blocked (Blocked meaning the damage reduced through block, not necessarily your total block value).
data.requirement: Target is the target of an attack.

data.name: Bloodbolt
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target.

Overcharge: You may spend X HP to increase the damage the attack deals by X. X may not exceed your Toughness.

data.name: Blue Soul
data.description: You start with the Hydromancer class unlocked and at level 2.

data.name: Blue Tide
data.description:
You create a 15ft radius zone of 1ft of water in a circle around yourself. This zone of water remains stationary at its original position, even after you move.

This zone lasts until the end of the encounter and automatically replenishes itself when Aqua Drill is used inside of it. You may have multiple of these zones active at once.

data.name: Bolting
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Lightning Damage with a bolt from the sky. On damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus x 3.

data.name: Bone Armor
data.description: You target and destroy a corpse within range to give yourself Bone Armor, which gives you a +2 bonus to your guard. Bone Armor lasts until the end of the encounter or until you take 2 or more damage from an attack.

data.name: Bottle Smash
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. After this attack, your improvised weapon breaks.

data.name: Bottle Toss
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. After this attack, your improvised weapon breaks.

data.name: Boundless Wind Stance
data.description:
You enter the Wind Stance, an unarmed style focusing around aerial combat. While in this stance, you may Hover and Fly up to your speed. If you already have a natural Flying speed or the Flight racial ability, your flying speed is increased  by 10ft.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance or make an attack with anything other than a melee attack or an ability with the Unarmed Strike keyword.

data.name: Break Away
data.description: You disengage and may move up to half your speed away from the nearest enemy.

data.name: Break Free
data.description: You may use this ability when you would be affected by a Stun, Root, Fear or a similar effect that would prevent you from acting that's inflicted by an enemy. You may immediately enter Rage Stance without spending any AP or RP. You gain immunity to this effect for the duration of the Rage.

data.name: Break Piggy Bank
data.description: You gain Haste, which gives you 2 AP for the rest of this turn. A target can only be affected by haste once per turn.

data.name: Brilliance
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target dealing Holy(Light) damage. On damage, inflict Illumination X, where X equals your Focus / 2 (rounded down) until the end of your next turn.

data.name: Bring out your dead
data.description:
You summon 3 zombies, as if you used Raise Undead 3 times. Restrictions on max zombie limit still apply.

Does not require corpses.

data.name: Bulk Orders
data.description: When purchasing five or more of the same item from an NPC or Procurement, reduce the total price by 10%. For commodities, you must purchase at least 4000 units.

data.name: Bullet Magnet
data.description: Until the start of your next turn, any single target Ranged Weapon Attack made against an ally in range is made against you instead.

data.name: Bunshin Tai no Jutsu
data.description:
You create a body double of yourself that has the same stats you do at the time of creation. You and the body double share the same HP, Mana, AP and RP etc and unless stated otherwise your clones are considered you. All effects on you are mirrored on your clone and vice versa, however a clone cannot benefit from Presence Concealment.

When taking an action, you may choose to let the user be yourself or the body double. However, the body double may only use basic abilities and abilities with the Ninjutsu keyword and cannot create more body doubles of itself. 

When you take the movement action or use a non-teleport movement ability, your clone may move for the same amount of distance as you moved.

You may spend 0 AP or 1 RP to dismiss the body double. A clone can never travel more than 300ft from your actual body, but while it lasts you may spend 2 AP to swap locations with it.

A clone lasts until you rest.

data.name: Burst Fire
data.description: You make 3 light attacks against the target.
data.requirement: Must be made with a pistol, musket or crossbow.

data.name: Call of the Grave
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals Dark damage. On hit, if the target is large or smaller, you pull them to you. They are Challenged until the start of your next turn. This ability does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

data.name: Call to Grace
data.description: You trigger the effect of Sanctify, healing the target of the attack by your sanctify amount (and reducing the sanctify stacks). If the attack targets multiple creatures, you only heal one.
data.requirement: An enemy within range that inflicted with Sanctify is attacking an ally.

data.name: Can't Escape Death
data.description: You may use this after an enemy leaves your melee range. After the target finishes moving, you may sidestep up to your speed towards them. For 1 RP, you may move double your speed instead.
data.requirement: A target Challenged by you leaves your melee range.

data.name: Cannonball
data.description:
You make 2 heavy attacks against the target and a light attack against all other enemies within 5ft of the target.

This secondary Light attack is affected by mods on your cannon that modify its basic attack splash.

data.name: Canter
data.description: You may Sidestep 10ft.
data.requirement: Must be mounted and can be used immediately after making a weapon attack.

data.name: Carpenter Basics
data.description:
Carpenter's Modification A
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an A-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Joining and Assembling
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You mix a special material into the carpentry project. Each material has its own crafting point cost.

Create Oil Coating
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create an Oil Coating from Carpenter materials.  See Items: Carpenter Materials.

Create Wood Block
Cost: Errand
Description:
You create a Wood Block from Carpenter materials.  See Items: Carpenter Materials.

Infuse Wand
Cost: 5 Crafting Points
Description: 
You add a drop of Oil Coating into a wand, changing the built in damage type to the element of the oil. Only works with oils that change the damage type. Does not consume the oil.

data.name: Castling
data.description: You swap positions with a Rook puppet piece you control.

data.name: Cat Form
data.description: You transform into cat form, reducing your Guard to 0 but increasing your Evasion by +3 and Dodge by +6.  Your size is tiny and you are able to occupy the same square as an ally.  While in Cat form the only attack you can make is Light Melee Attack.  If you take damage in Cat Form, you immediately return to your normal form.  You can dispel this form for 0 AP or 1 RP.

data.name: Catalyze
data.description: The target must succeed at a Save. On failure, you inflict Stagger II or Sunder II until the end of your next turn.

data.name: Cavalry Charge
data.description:
You may spend up to 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement. You automatically gain the Trample effect as like the Trample ability once you have moved 20ft.

For every 10ft moved, the attack you make as part of the Trample effect gains +1 bonus damage, up to a maximum of +10.

data.name: Cavalry Heal
data.description: You heal the target for 11 + (Power x 2). If the target is mounted, their mount gets healed for the same amount.

data.name: Cave Raider
data.description: Until the start of your next turn, you gain the ability to climb your speed.  In addition if you have rope, you can tie it to a secure object and you can rappel down a cliffside up to 50ft at the cost of 5ft of movement.

data.name: Chain Lightning
data.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target dealing Lightning Damage and inflicting Static X where X equals your Focus x 3. On damage, you may repeat this attack against another target within 30ft of the target without paying additional costs. This attack may repeat multiple times like this.

You cannot target the same creature more than once per use of this ability.

data.name: Chair Grab
data.description: You grab a nearby unattended object and are able to use it as an improvised weapon.

data.name: Channel Eidolon
data.description: You use the ability granted by your attuned Eidolon. All costs and effects are determined by your attunement.

data.name: Channel Eidolon: Distracting Swarm
data.description:
You summon a distracting swarm around a target. The target immediately loses any Concentration effects and suffers -5 penalty to Perception checks unless they spend 1 RP to sidestep out of the effect. If they did not move, they also cannot use any abilities with the Concentration keyword until they move.

You can only have 1 Distracting Swarm active at the same time.

data.name: Channel Eidolon: Draw Luck
data.description:
You draw on your luck, manipulating the circumstances around you to the best possible state. If you are the target of an attack, that attack becomes a 1. If you made a roll, that roll becomes a 20 (despite the pact cost). 

May also be used in situations that don’t have you making a roll, such as flipping a coin, but the act that you’re influencing cannot take more than 5 seconds to complete.

After using this ability, you become temporarily afflicted with bad luck. The GM decides what exactly happens and what triggers it, but it could turn your roll into a 1, make an enemy roll a 20 against you or something related to the environment. After a bad luck action happens, the bad luck is removed.

You cannot use this ability again until after the bad luck has been removed.

data.name: Channel Eidolon: Vine Wall Cover
data.description:
Thick vines sprout from the ground or natural wall as you create a 5x5 wall of vines that is 10ft high. The wall of vines counts as full cover (unless you peek from it) and has HP equal to your Toughness x6. The vines are sturdy enough to stand on.

Lasts for up to 5 minutes and you can only have 5 instances of Vine Wall Cover at one time.

data.name: Charge
data.description:
You may spend 2 or 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement.

After you finish moving, you may spend half of the AP you used on this ability on basic Light, Heavy or Precise Melee Attacks.

data.name: Charm
data.description: The target must make a Save or be charmed by you until the end of the encounter.

data.name: Check
data.description:
You move a puppet piece in such a way (following Move Piece rules) that it can attack an enemy if it moves again. It cannot attack with this movement.

At the start of your next turn, you may move that piece as if you used Move Piece without spending AP/Mana or it counting as an ability use.

data.name: Chemical Explosive
data.description: You place a Chemical Explosive package that detonates after one minute. The explosion has a 15 ft radius and deals Double Heavy damage. The package makes an obvious noise after it has been planted that can be heard within the radius. The explosive charge deals 5x damage against inanimate objects. You can create a Chemical Explosive during an interlude phase for free, but can only carry one at a time. The check to disable a Chemical Explosive is equal to 20 + 2 x Power of the creator.

data.name: Chiburi Noto
data.description: You clean the blood off your katana and sheath the blade. If your next Iai strike with this weapon during this arc is a hit, its Roll Damage is maximized.
data.requirement: Must have used an ability with the Iaijutsu keyword with the chosen weapon this encounter.

data.name: Chiburi Noto II
data.description: You clean the blood off your katana and sheath the blade. If your next Iai strike with this weapon during this arc is a hit, its Roll Damage is maximized and it gains Full Pierce.
data.requirement: Must have used an ability with the Iaijutsu keyword with the chosen weapon this encounter.

data.name: Chilling Cold
data.description: You can emit a cooling wind within 30ft that counters the effects of most hot weather. You can enable or disable this every 1 second. In addition you gain Elemental Mastery: Frost.

data.name: Circle Swing
data.description: You make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you may move the target to anywhere in your weapon range (Max 10ft) , then push it 5ft. The target must remain at the same height it was before this ability was used. Your next Spell or Channeling Weapon attack this turn costs 1 less AP (Min 0).

data.name: Circuit Reset
data.description: You reset your circuits, allowing you to once again benefit from the Circuit effect.

data.name: Clearcasting
data.description: The next Spell you cast this encounter has its mana cost reduced by 2. This cannot reduce the mana cost below 0.

data.name: Cleave
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target. On damage, you deal Half Pierce Physical damage equal to your Power to all other enemies within 5ft of the target.

If you miss the attack and use Aftershock in reaction to this missing, Aftershock mana cost is reduced by 1 for that use.

data.name: Cloak of Bats
data.description: You vanish into a swarm of bats and reappear somewhere else within range. If this was used in reaction to an attack, that attack automatically misses you.

data.name: Cloud Piercing Claw
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, they are knocked airborne 20ft until the end of your turn (if this attack is made outside of your turn, they drop immediately). They are NOT knocked prone from this, but do take fall damage like normal.

You may Sidestep up to 25ft into the air after making this attack, regardless of if you did damage with it.

Combo: If used after entering Boundless Wind Stance, the mana cost of this ability is reduced by 1.

data.name: Cloudstep
data.description: You may Sidestep up to half your speed. This movement ignores difficult terrain.
data.requirement: Must be the first movement action in your turn.

data.name: Code Blue
data.description:
You may sidestep up to your speed towards an ally and must end this movement within 5ft of them.

Your next Painkiller Injection or the AP spending of First Aid used this turn has its AP cost reduced by 1.

data.name: Combat Chemistry
data.description:
Can only be used once per encounter. 

Using your knowledge of alchemy, you jury-rig a special item that has the effect of an an elixir, poison, flask or potion with a cost of 300c or lower. 

You can only make the base version of the item with no mods. The item doesn't take up burden, but must be used before the start of your next turn or it is lost. This item can only be used by you.

data.name: Comet
data.description: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target that deals Arcane damage.

data.name: Command Undead
data.description: You may have one of your Necromancer summons act as if they had spent 1 AP.

data.name: Compression
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target that deals Physical (Crushing) damage.

If the target is Large Size or bigger, the mana cost of this is reduced by 1.

data.name: Concealed Shot
data.description: You gain the Hiding state from anyone you have cover or concealment from.
data.requirement: Only usable after attacking with a Sniper Rifle while stealthed.

data.name: Conduit
data.description:
When Mind Connection is active, you can channel some abilities through others with Mind Connection. You cannot use conduit with abilities that require a physical object to be present, such as a Mystic Eye power or a specific weapon or abilities that require you to interact with a physical object, such as Snatch. Abilities that require your physical body to make an attack, such as Double Punch also don't work.

You still must pay the costs to use the abilities, and your Mind Connection source becomes the origin point of the spell for purposes of range. Abilities with a range of Self cannot be used through Conduit.

Any ability used through Conduit that isn't an Aetherie ability costs +1 AP (or RP) to use.

data.name: Consecrating Bolt
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target that deals Holy damage. On damage, you inflict Sanctify 1

data.name: Consistent Shot
data.description:
You may make a Precise Attack against the target. This attack deals Heavy Damage instead.

This attack does not gain Pinpoint.

data.name: Consume Enemy
data.description: You eat the body of a deceased enemy, healing you for your Toughness x 2, regaining 1 mana and preventing a single injury.

data.name: Consume Fire
data.description:
You gain Consume Fire, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 Fire against the triggering damage. If the attacker is not yourself or from an effect caused by you, you can then spend 2 Mana to heal for the original damage amount, up to 100 HP.

Any on hit effects from the damage do not apply if you took 0 damage from it because of your DR.

data.name: Consume Lightning
data.description:
You gain Consume Lightning, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 Lightning for the triggering damage. If you reduce damage in any way from this ability and the cause of this damage is not you or from an effect caused by you, you gain Lightning Boost. Lightning Boost grants a damage bonus on your next Lightning Elemental Attack equal to the attacker’s power. This damage bonus is doubled on heavy attacks.

Any on hit effects from the damage do not apply if you took 0 damage from it because of your DR.
data.requirement: You are about to take Lightning damage

data.name: Consume Wind
data.description:
You gain Consume Wind, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 Wind for the triggering damage. If you reduce damage in any way from this ability and the cause of this damage is not you or from an effect caused by you, you gain Wind Boost. Wind Boost gives you an increase to your movement speed for the next turn equal to the damage reduced by this ability, rounded down to the nearest multiple of 5.

Any on hit effects from the damage do not apply if you took 0 damage from it because of your DR.
data.requirement: You are about to take Wind damage.

data.name: Converging Blow
data.description: You and your Manifestation both make a Heavy attack against the same target within range of both of you.

data.name: Corona Burst
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target that deals Fire damage. For every 20ft of distance the target is away from you, this deals +1 damage. (Up to a maximum of +12)

data.name: Corpse Domination
data.description: You raise the target under your command. A target raised in this way is treated as a non-heroic unit that takes its own actions, however it will try to act in a way that is most helpful to you in the fight. The raised target keeps all of its stats and abilities it had in life, though it only starts with half its maximum health (before any reductions) and whatever mana it had left over when it died. This summon lasts until the end of the encounter or until its HP reaches 0, upon which it immediately dies again and cannot be raised again in any way.
data.requirement: Target must be a dead humanoid.

data.name: Corpse Explosion
data.description: You detonate 1 of your zombies, making a Light Attack that deals Dark damage against all creatures in range but killing the zombie. You may detonate additional zombies when using this ability to increase the damage this deals by 2 for each additional zombie.
data.requirement: Must have an active zombie from Raise Undead.

data.name: Corpse Puppetry
data.description:
You may control a corpse less than a week old within 30ft of you to perform simple actions, such as moving or talking. 

A corpse used this way has no combat stats and cannot attack.

data.name: Counter Stance
data.description:
You enter a stance in which you freely counterattack against enemies that attack you. After an attack against you has resolved, you may make a Melee Attack of Opportunity against that target. While in this stance, you cannot use the Dodge or Block reactions.

You may spend 0 AP or 1 RP to cancel this stance. It otherwise lasts until you enter another stance.

data.name: Counter-Potion
data.description: You may immediately use a Potion, Elixir, Salve, Poison or Flask that is held in your hand.  X is equal to the AP cost of the action.

data.name: Countershot
data.description: You may make a Precise Attack against the incoming attack. If your accuracy check matches or beats the enemy’s accuracy check, you shoot down the incoming arrow and the attack is negated.
data.requirement: You or an ally are targeted by a ranged weapon attack.

data.name: Counterspell
data.description:
You pay RP equal to half the AP spent on the triggering Spell (rounded up) or equal to the RP spent on the triggering spell and Counter it, canceling its effect without refunding the AP. If the AP cost is higher than your RP, you cannot Counterspell it. 

If used against a non-Grunt target, you must pay 1 mana for each point of Focus that the target has more than you (minimum 0). 

This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity, but cannot be used to Counter Spells that have an AP and RP cost of 0.
data.requirement: An enemy casts a spell within range

data.name: Craft Artificer's Glove
data.description:
You create a personalized Artificer’s Glove that only you have proficiency with.  Choose a glove type with properties of your choosing at the time of creation.  You can modify this glove for an errand action to change the property, but you can only have one property at a time and only one Artificer’s glove at a time.

Gamma Glove (Hacker): Artifice Jamming. For 1 RP you can Jam a small shell artifice within 120ft causing it to malfunction and be unusable until the user spends 1 AP to clear the jam.

Sigma Glove (Combat Artificer): Heat Sink.  0 RP, 1 mana.  Your glove emits frost energy that saps heat from an artifice, allowing it to bypass the once per turn limit a single time. Overcharge: 1 RP, the mana cost becomes 0.

Delta Glove (Specialist):  The glove is specialized for an expertise skill granting you +10 in that skill.  For instance, it might fire an arcane blast to propel you, granting you +10 to jumping. May not choose artisan or gathering skils.

data.name: Craft Pemmican
data.description:
Errand. You turn up to 1000u of food into 25 Pemmican Bars (40u of food per bar), which are incredibly shelf stable and easy to eat.  They perform about the same as Military Rations but they are wrapped by special leaves that deter pests—useful and consistent adventure food.

You may also use this as an IP action to convert up to 2000u of food into 50 Pemmican bars.

data.name: Crashing Foam Wave
data.description: Creates a wave of water originating from a point of water within range.  Shoves an adjacent target of size large or smaller 10ft away from the point of origin.  If the target is on top of the water, you can choose to shove the target in any direction.  You can use either AP or RP for the cost of this ability.

data.name: Create Talisman
data.description:
You may create a talisman or scroll by spending an interlude point. Choose an Spell that you know or choose a specialized talisman, such as a Sealing Talisman. You inscribe that Spell onto a piece of paper. A talisman of a Spell allows you to use the Spell at a different time. When you use it, it is consumed. A Spell talisman costs as much AP and mana to use as the original Spell does. 

You may craft up to 5 talismans per interlude point. A secret art talisman takes up 3 of these slots. When crafting, you may make no more than 2 of the same spell. A crafted talisman costs 1 burden to carry with you. A Secret Art talisman costs 2 burden and can only be used through the Secret Talisman ability.

Crafting a talisman costs 100 calligraphy units per AP and Mana of the spell. A spell with no AP or Mana costs 50 units. If the spell has an RP cost and no AP cost, it costs 200u per RP. If the spell has a casting time longer than 4 AP (ie 10 minutes), then treat the spell as having a cost of 4 AP.

Some spells, such as Summon Lesser Eidolon and Summon Eidolon may be unavailable.

data.name: Crescent Sweep
data.description: You make a Light Attack against all enemies in range. On damage, a target falls Prone.

data.name: Crimson Enmity
data.description: When your HP is at or below 50% of your max HP in an Encounter, you gain Crimson Enmity. When you would heal an ally or yourself with an ability from this class (Bloodbinder), you heal for 1.5x that amount.

data.name: Crippling Attack
data.description: You make a Light Attack against the target. On damage the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

data.name: Crippling Poison
data.description:
You slow the target for their movement. 

Overcharge: You may spend 1 additional mana to make it affect a movement not reliant on movement speed, something that moves a fixed distance. The distance moved with that is halved. If that movement had an attack attached that now cannot be made, the ability is NOT refunded.
data.requirement: Target suffering from your Toxic takes a movement action.

data.name: Crucified by Radiance
data.description:
You make a light attack that deals Holy(Light) to any targets in a 5ft wide line. At any point of the line you can draw a second 55ft long perpendicular line centered on that point of the initial line. You make another Light attack against all caught on this second line and on damage you inflict Illumination X where X is your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn.

If a target gets hit by both lines, the second line deals Heavy damage and inflicts your full Focus in Illumination instead.

data.name: Crusader's Advance
data.description: You teleport to an empty square next to an enemy you marked with the Mark of Justice.
data.requirement: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

data.name: Culinary Basics
data.description:
Mushroom Stock
Cost: 15 Crafting Points
Description: 
Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Mushroom Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Focus Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours. Requires 1 Box of Fresh Mushrooms. 

Meaty Stock
Cost: 15 Crafting Points
Description: 
Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Meaty Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Power Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours.  Requires 1 Box of Fresh Meat.

Fish Stock
Cost: 15 Crafting Points
Description: 
Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Fish Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Toughness Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours.  Requires 1 Box of Fresh Fish.

Vegetable Stock
Cost: 15 Crafting Points
Description: 
Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Vegetable Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Agility Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours.  Requires 1 Box of Fresh Vegetables.

Spicy Stock
Cost: 30 Crafting Points
Description: 
Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Spicy Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Crafting Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours.  Requires 1 bundle of Spicy Peppers.

Herbal Stock
Cost: 30 Crafting Points
Description: 
Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Herbal Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Gathering Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours. Requires 1 bundle of Fresh Cooking Herbs. When gathering from a node with a bonus from this stock, you keep the benefit for that entire node unless you go a day without harvesting from that node.

Stir Layered Flavors
Cost: 30 Crafting Points
Description: 
Allows you to add another flavor, allowing you to add a second different flavor.  Choose from Mushroom, Meaty, Fish, Vegetable, Spicy or Herbal—then add the corresponding ingredient.  For example:  A Mushroom stock + Meaty stock becomes a Mushroom-Meaty stock that grants +1 Power / +1 Focus Food Bonus.  

Use Every Last Drop
Cost: 15 Crafting Points
Description:  
Increases the stock yield by 2.

Secret Ingredient
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You mix a special material into the stock.  Each material has its own crafting point cost.

Create Box or Bundle of Food
Cost: Errand.
Description: 
You create a perfect mix of ingredients that would be worthy of a stock with 500u of matching material.  Example:  500u of Meat can make 1 Box of Fresh Meat.  You can make 5 boxes of any kind for one errand action.

data.name: Cure Touch
data.description: You heal the target for 11 + Power x 2

data.name: Cure Touch II
data.description: You Heal the target for 22 + (4 x Power)

data.name: Cure Water
data.description: You cast this ability on water within range, healing a target within 30ft for 11 + Power x 2. You can use either AP or RP for the cost of this ability.

data.name: Cursed Evil Eye
data.description:
You open your Cursed Mystic Eye that curses everything in sight.

All targets in a 90 degree cone up to range must make a save against your Potency or take Light Dark(Curse) damage.

Upkeep: 1 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack.

data.name: Cut Away
data.description: Instead of rolling a save normally, you may make a Precise Attack against the Potency of the ability instead. If your accuracy roll beats the Potency, you are treated as having passed the save.
data.requirement: You are the target of an ability that forces you to make a save.

data.name: Cut Magic
data.description:
You make a Heavy Attack against a temporary magic effect. If your accuracy roll is equal or higher than the Potency of the effect, the effect is removed.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 additional AP to turn the Heavy attack into a Precise attack instead.

data.name: Cyclone
data.description: All targets in a 15x15 ft area must make a save against your Potency or be knocked airborne for 10ft, falling Prone once they land.

data.name: Dark Barrier
data.description:
You and up to 4 other willing allies within range take Light Dark damage. Afterwards they gain temporary HP until end of encounter equal to double the damage taken.

You may choose to ignore Dark resistance or damage reduction on your allies for this ability.

data.name: Dark Bolt
data.description: You fire a bolt of darkness at a target, making a Light Attack that deals Dark Damage. You may take true damage equal to your Power + 3 to give this ability Full Pierce.

data.name: Dark Healing
data.description:
You take Light (1 AP) or Heavy damage (2 AP), then heal a target within range an amount equal to damage taken.

You may choose to ignore Dark resistance or damage reduction on yourself for this damage.

data.name: Darkness
data.description:
You conjure a 15x15ft area of pure darkness within range. The darkness blocks line of sight. Targets inside of or within 5ft of the Darkness can only see up to 5ft into or out of Darkness. In addition, any targets within the Darkness that do not have Darkvision or a similar ability that lets them see in darkness are considered Blinded 2 (nightvision does not apply).

This lasts for up to 10 minutes and you may end this effect for 0 AP.

The mana cost of this ability is reduced by 2 during the night.

data.name: Darkvision
data.description: You touch an ally and share your Darkvision with them until the end of the encounter, letting them see up 60ft in the darkness.

data.name: Darkvision (passive)
data.description: You gain 60ft darkvision, allowing you to see perfectly in the dark even without a source of light.

data.name: Deadly Venom
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you worsen the target’s Toxic, letting it stack and adding +1 stack to it. Stacks a maximum of 3 times.

A Toxic with more than 1 stack deals damage at the end of the target’s turn rather than the start.
data.requirement: Must be made with a melee weapon or with a Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

data.name: Death Mark
data.description:
You mentally mark a target for death by applying Death Mark, opening them up to your Assassin abilities.

On Killing Blow against a target marked by Death Mark, you may Sidestep up to your Speed and take the Hide action for 0 RP.

data.name: Death Perception
data.description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of all living units within range until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). Only affects unit in your line of sight when you use this ability, if more enemies join the fight later they are not affected until you use this ability again.

data.name: Decipher Magic
data.description:
You may start a skill challenge against a magic effect you can see in an attempt to understand it.  

You are able to disable tier 1 bounded fields with this ability.

data.name: Deckbreaker
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you inflict Offstep on the target for the next attack against it.

If the target is inflicted with Stagger, the mana cost of this is reduced by 1.

If you're under the effects of Exposing Edge, this attack gains Lock On.

data.name: Deconstruction
data.description:
By spending an Interlude Point, you deconstruct a basic item into materials. You gain 500 matching crafting material per ingot or block used in the item. If the item does not use ingots, you instead get 1 matching crafting material per clim value of the item.

Regardless of the material used in the item, you will only gain the base price amount even if using upgraded materials and all alloys and upgrades are lost.  You can deconstruct up to 5 basic items for 1 interlude point.

Alternatively instead of 1 basic item, you can transmute up to 1000u of random junk into up to 250u of usable basic (ie: Iron, Pine etc) Blacksmithing Materials, Armorsmithing Materials, Carpentry Materials, Calligraphy Material, Magical Fuel Materials or Medical Materials units at a 4:1 ratio.

You can also use Deconstruction as an Errand Action, but the deconstruction limit is reduced to 1 basic item instead of 5 basic items.

data.name: Decree
data.description:
You command the target to Approach or Flee.

The target must make a Save or be forced to obey your chosen command, immediately moving up to their speed towards you (if you chose approach) or away from you (if you chose flee).

data.name: Defensive Flexibility
data.description: You react to the triggering attack with the opposite reaction you used to meet the requirement of this ability. (IE if you used Dodge as your last reaction, you use the Block reaction for this).
data.requirement: Must be the target of an attack and must have reacted to the previous attack against you with the Dodge or Block action.

data.name: Delay Time
data.description:
You choose one or more negative effects on the target that would trigger at the start or end of their turn. They trigger on the turn after the turn they would normally trigger instead. 

You may only delay an effect once, but you are able to delay Stasis even though the target is normally immune to all abilities.

Start of turn effects still trigger at the start of the turn and end of turn effects still trigger at the end of the turn.

data.name: Delayed Hit
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target, but don’t deal damage. On hit, even if it was guarded, the target takes Heavy Damage at the start of your next turn. (This delayed damage is calculated of the target’s Guard at the time it’s applied, not when the attack hit)

data.name: Demonblood Regeneration
data.description:
You heal faster than those of other races. You gain the following benefits:

  • When using Grit, you heal for 6 HP instead.
  • When using Second Wind, you heal for an additional 3 HP.

data.name: Dense Frame
data.description: When you would be pushed back by an effect, you are shoved for 5ft less.

data.name: Dense Mana
data.description: You augment your next ability, increasing the Potency of your next ability by 2.

data.name: Density Break
data.description: You make a Precise attack that deals damage equal to the target’s Toughness.

data.name: Despair of Isolation
data.description:
Everyone within your Mist of the Vale becomes Slowed until the end of their next turn. They must also make a Save or become Dazed until the end of their next turn. On failure, they also cannot target allies with friendly effects while in the mist until the end of their next turn.

You may spend 1 Mana to exclude allies from this attack.
data.requirement: Mist of the Vale must be active.

data.name: Destroy
data.description: The target must make a Save or take Heavy Dark(Curse) damage.

data.name: Destroy Ground
data.description:
You destroy natural earth with magical speed, creating up to a 10ft x 10ft x 10ft hole in most natural earth. Those caught in the effect may spend 1 RP to Sidestep 5ft out of the effect. All caught in the effect fall down 10ft into the hole and take falling damage as normal.

The spell requires natural ground to be below the touching surface to function. It may work on the bottom floor of a house, but will fail if used higher up or in some dungeons

data.name: Destroying Angel
data.description: You make a Precise Attack against an enemy unit within range, dealing Poison Damage. On damage, if the enemy is a Grunt, they are immediately reduced to negative their Max HP and die. On Killing Blow, the current host of Spore Symbiote is healed for 5 + Power x 2.

data.name: Detailed Finish
data.description: Make a crafting check. Upgrade the dice to 2d8.
data.requirement: This is your last crafting dice. Costs 1 Crafting Dice.

data.name: Deus Vult
data.description:
Can use with active Holy Orders. Your next basic attack or Ave Maria against your Holy Order gains the Lock On and Shieldbreaker keywords against your Holy Order.

Must be used before you make an attack and cannot be used in reaction to an ongoing attack.

data.name: Devastating Strike
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target.

data.name: Devastating Strike II
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target. The dice are maximized instead of rolling.

data.name: Devastating Strike III
data.description: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target.
data.requirement: Target must have 0 RP remaining and must be marked by Death Mark. One-handed weapons only.

data.name: Devil's Blow
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack does NOT have Full Pierce.

If you roll a 1 on the accuracy check, you take full pierce damage of same the type as the attack equal to the damage roll of the attack. You also regain the mana spent on this.

data.name: Devil's Curse
data.description:
The attacker takes damage equal to the damage roll of the triggering attack. They cannot Dodge or Block this damage.

Does not work against Secret Arts, Climax Arts or similar level abilities.
data.requirement: An enemy accuracy check against you rolls a 1.

data.name: Dharani: Blooming Conciousness
data.description:
You release all gathered harmony as petals of radiant light that spiral outward from your body.

You consume all Harmony stacks and 1 mana per stack to heal all allies within range for (6 + Your focus) / 2 for each stack consumed.

If you do not have enough mana for all stacks, this ability instead consumes stacks equal to the mana you can spend.
data.requirement: Must be in Luminous Form Stance and have 5 stacks of Harmony.

data.name: Dimensional Armory Expansion
data.description: Your burden limit for your Dimensional Armory is increased by 4.  Ahead of time, you designate one armor, one cloak and one weapon/shield or two weapons or one two-handed weapon that are inside of your Dimensional Armory as a “dimensional set”, this process takes 15 minutes of concentration.  You can only have one dimensional set at a time.

data.name: Dirge of Despair
data.description:
All enemies within range must make a save against your Potency or become affected by this Song. While affected, you may subtract 1d4 from a single roll they make until the start of your next turn. You may choose to add this after seeing the roll.

Upkeep: At the start of your next turn and every turn thereafter, you may spend 1 AP to continue this performance. Enemies that successfully made their save, do not have to save again against this continued performance, but those who were affected continue to be affected.

data.name: Disarming Attack
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you Disarm the target until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Disarming Shot
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. If the attack beat the passive evasion of the target (before Dodge bonuses), you Disarm the target until the start of your next turn. The target may spend 1 RP to avoid the disarm effect. This is in addition to any RP the target may spend to avoid the attack itself.

data.name: Discern Immunities
data.description:
You look at a single target and glean what its resistances are until the end of the encounter. When you are about to use an ability with a negative effect that would be passively negated by the target, you become aware of this and may cancel your action.

Does not apply if the target has an active ability that can remove it, such as a paladin’s Paragon of Virtue for example.

data.name: Discipline
data.description: Instead of rolling, you can choose instead to accept 10 as the dice value for a skill check.
data.requirement: You have at least 5 skill points in the called for skill. Use when you need to roll a skill check.

data.name: Dispel Magic
data.description: You dispel a temporary magic effect from an area or target. All non-permanent effects within range that are created by an ability with the Spell or Enchantment keyword are affected. Spells that do not have a time limit listed or create a permanent effect such as a Geomancer's fissure are not affected. Bounded Fields and Secret Arts cannot be removed with Dispel Magic.

data.name: Disrupt Ki
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, if they have any Concentration ability active, that ability immediately ends as if they had chosen to drop it.

data.name: Divine Barrage
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target and instruct others to follow your lead.

X allies other than you within 30ft of you may also make a Light attack against the same target.

data.name: Divine Guard
data.description: You may immediately use the Block action to guard against the triggering attack with a +5 bonus to Guard.
data.requirement: Must be transformed by Divine Release and targeted by an attack.

data.name: Divine Might
data.description: You make a Light Attack against the target.

data.name: Divine Providence
data.description:
When you use this ability you choose one of the following effects:

 

Divine Protection: You are protected from harm through divine protection, gaining 100 damage reduction against the next source of damage you take.

Fortune: When used for this effect, this ability becomes Instant. You may reroll your last d20 and take the new result.

Health: You heal someone (or yourself) within touching distance for 15 hp.

Light: You summon a bright light at your position that shines a bright light up to 30ft around you. You may detonate this light by spending 0 AP to Daze all enemies within its range.

 

Once you use this ability, you may not use it again until after a rest.

data.name: Divine Release
data.description:
Demons can feed on their own lifeforce to release a brilliant display of divine powers. Horns can elongate, fangs might grow, eyes glow and even wings can sprout as the Demon realizes their Divine Roots.

Upkeep: 11 HP

You transform into your new form and take 11 true damage. You may end this form at any time by spending 0 RP. While the form lasts you gain the following benefits:

Fallen Guard: When you take the Block basic action, you gain an additional +5 to guard.
Fallen Alacrity: You gain +5 movement speed and the ability to fly.
Fallen Might: You gain +1 AP at the start of your turn.
Fallen Conviction: When you are reduced to 0 HP, you do not enter the downed state. You still receive the wounded status. While at or below 0 HP, the upkeep for this ability is increased to 16. If you end this ability while at or below 0 HP, you are immediately placed into the downed state. If your HP become equal to or lower than your negative maximum HP, you are immediately incapacitated and this ability ends.

Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until you finish an interlude rest phase.

data.name: Divine Smite
data.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Holy Damage against the target. If your target’s HP is lower than the max damage your attack would deal, this attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage instead of rolling.

This calculation only involves your base damage (Base weapon damage + the power). Any other effects added to the damage such as Heavy Blade's bonus damage, Anathema on target etc do not affect the calculation and aren't maximized.
data.requirement: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

data.name: Divine Smite II
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Holy Damage against the target. On damage, you may give yourself or an ally within 30ft temporary HP equal your 5+Power until the end of the encounter.

data.name: Divine Storm
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack with your weapon against the target of your Mark of Justice.

You then make a Light attack against all other enemies within 5ft and push them back 10ft, regardless of whether the attack hit or not. This light attack is not made with your weapon and always does the damage type of your god (as determined by your Holy weapon key ability).
data.requirement: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

data.name: Divining Petalfall
data.description: Make a gathering check with a +5 bonus. If the final dice value is even, add it to Node Points. If it’s odd, add it to Lucky Points.

data.name: Doctor Jekyll
data.description: You draw and either drink a Potion or Elixir, or throw one to a willing ally within 30ft who immediately drinks it.

data.name: Dog Form
data.description:
You transform into your Dog Form, becoming a medium size dog. You lose 2 guard and 4 block, but gain a +1 Size bonus to Evasion and Dodge.

While in Dog Form, you can only make melee unarmed attacks and you are considered proficient in these attacks. 

If you take damage in Dog Form, you immediately return to your normal form. You can dispel this form for 0 AP or 1 RP.

data.name: Doom
data.description: The target must make a Save. On failure, they take additional light damage the next time they take damage that isn't true damage.

data.name: Double Elements
data.description: Your next Elemental Strike or Elemental Sweep ability used this turn may add in the effect of another element. This element must be one you have mastered and different from the effect that's already dealt by the attack.

data.name: Double Palm Strike
data.description: You attack the target for Light Damage. On damage, the target is moved up to 15ft away from you (At least 5 feet).

data.name: Double Punch
data.description: You may make two Light Attacks against the same target.
data.requirement: Must not have made a dual wield attack this turn.

data.name: Double Slam
data.description:
You may make up to 2 Light attacks against the target, paying 1 AP and 1 Mana for each. On damage of either hit, the target becomes Unbalanced. If the target is already unbalanced, they are knocked prone.

If you are wielding only 1 Two-Handed weapon, you are limited to 1 attack.

data.name: Downburst
data.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Wind damage against the target. 

On damage, the target immediately plummets to the ground and takes falling damage. This falling damage cannot be negated through the use of abilities that would normally negate falling damage.

data.name: Downburst II
data.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Wind damage against the target. 

On damage, the target immediately plummets to the ground and takes falling damage. This falling damage cannot be negated through the use of abilities that would normally negate falling damage.
data.requirement: Target is knocked airborne or is Flying.

data.name: Draconic Presence
data.description: You gain a +10 bonus to Negotiation and Intimidation checks against Grunts and against Heroics that have a lower Spirit Core than you.

data.name: Dragon Breaks The Ranks
data.description:
You gain Flight and surround yourself in fire, then Sidestep to a point in a direct line. You destroy low cover you pass through, though the GM may rule that some cover is too sturdy to be destroyed. In either case, you continue until you reach the target and may make a single melee Heavy Attack against an enemy in range with your weapon. Any other characters in your path may spend 1 RP to move 5ft out of your charge or take Light Fire Damage.

If you have an element mastered, you may change the Fire damage of this ability to the element you have mastered.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

data.name: Dragon's Breath
data.description: You exhale a devastating breath attack, making a ranged Light attack against all targets in a 30ft long 60 degree cone. This attack deals the same type of damage as your element chosen in Ryujin's Mastery.

data.name: Dragonfire Dive
data.description: You jump to the target, not provoking any attacks of opportunity, and attacking the target plus all other creatures within 5ft of the target for Heavy Fire Damage.

data.name: Dramatic Death
data.description:
You fall prone and may immediately use the Play Dead action. You may use your Art(Mime) for this roll instead of Deception.

At the start of your turn, you may stop playing dead and immediately stand up from prone for 0 AP.
data.requirement: You've taken damage and that damage is done resolving.

data.name: Draw Elements
data.description: You may choose an element. Until the start of your next turn, you are considered to have mastered that element.

data.name: Draw Elements II
data.description: You may choose an element. Until the start of your next turn, you are considered to have mastered that element.

data.name: Draw-In
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, they are pulled up to 5ft towards you.

Combo: If used after Lunge, the range of this attack and the pullback distance are doubled. This consumes the Lunge effect.

data.name: Driftwind Evasion
data.description:
