You take the Dodge action against the attack and gain a Windflow bonus to your Dodge equal to your Windflow stacks.

Afterwards, you lose all Windflow stacks.

data.name: Drink to Battle
data.description: You drink some Alcohol in preparation for a battle, granting you 1 stack of Tipsy.

data.name: Dualcast
data.description: You immediately repeat the last used ability with the same target. Any cost must be paid as normal.
data.requirement: Must be used immediately after successfully using an ability with the spell keyword.

data.name: Duelist Blow
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target. Your next Block or Dodge reaction against that target costs 0 RP. This benefit disappears when you use an RP ability against a target other than the target of this ability.

data.name: Dullahan's Mount
data.description:
You conjure up a black horse that becomes part of you. You immediately mount when using this ability and upon dismounting, the horse vanishes. While mounted, your movement speed is increased by 30ft and you are considered a large creature, but you may only move in a straight line. When attempting to move through 5ft wide spaces, it is considered difficult terrain for you. You also suffer a -10 penalty to most finesse athletics checks as well as climbing and swimming checks while mounted.

Any attack against the horse is considered an attack against you instead. As the horse is considered part of you, any displacement or teleport abilities move the horse alongside with you. You may dismount by spending 0 AP.

data.name: Duplicate
data.description:
You attempt to analyze the spell and duplicate it. After the triggering spell resolves, immediately cast a copy of it. You must select a valid target for this copy, pay any additional mana cost originally on the spell as well as pay any costs that are not AP or RP. Failure to do so will make the duplicated spell fizzle, dissipating the magic harmlessly into the air.

Upon successfully copying the spell, it resolves with the same damage and effects as the original spell, though using your stats to resolve them.

The cost is 1 RP for a 0-2 AP spell or 2 RP for a 3-4 AP spell. Spells with a higher cost cannot be duplicated.

Secret Arts and Esoteric Arts also cannot be duplicated and upon attempting to do so, this ability is canceled and any cost refunded. Unique spells by heroic or boss enemies may also be impossible to duplicate (GM's discretion).
data.requirement: An enemy in range casts a Spell

data.name: Dust Kick
data.description:
You kick the ground in front of you, causing a veil of dust to appear. The target becomes Blinded 3 until the attack resolves. If the triggering attack misses, you kick the target and may push it 5ft into any horizontal direction.

If under the effects of Exposing Edge, you apply Blinded 5 instead.
data.requirement: Must be within 5ft of the ground. An ally or you are being attacked by an attack from enemy in range.

data.name: Eagle Hunt
data.description: You leap up to 30ft into the air and then horizontally up to twice your Speed, this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. You may use Silentium at any point during the movement, gaining the Combo bonus.

data.name: Earth Armor
data.description: You touch a willing ally’s armor and enchant it with earthen power. Until the end of the encounter, it grants a +1 guard and +4 block bonus.

data.name: Earth Infusion
data.description:
You surround a willing target in mud and rocks, changing their typing to Earth II. 

As an Earth II type, they take half damage from Lightning and Earth damage or attacks with the Lightning or Earth keyword unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Wind damage or attacks with the Wind keyword.

data.name: Earth Shield
data.description: You grant the target 1 RP they must spend on the Block action against the triggering attack. They gain a bonus to their Block for this action equal to your focus x 2.
data.requirement: An ally within range is the target of a melee attack and/or physical attack.

data.name: Earthen Divide
data.description:
You create a wall up to 20ft high, 5ft wide and 20ft long in a straight line. Each Segment of the wall has HP equal to 20 + Focus.

Overcharge: You may spend X mana to increase the length by 20 x Xft.

data.name: Earthen Guardian
data.description: You jump and sidestep towards the attacked ally and the triggering attack resolves against you instead. You automatically take the Block action against this attack.
data.requirement: In Steadfast Earth Stance, ally within range is the target of an attack.

data.name: Eat Anything
data.description: You may eat Junk units as food and it restores mana as usual, but it cannot be used with stocks.

data.name: Eclipse Breaker
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack against all targets in a 15x15ft line.

You must choose the line direction when starting the ability.

data.name: Efficient Strike
data.description: Make a gathering check and apply it to NP. If this maxes node points, all overflow is converted into lucky points.

data.name: Elbow Uppercut
data.description: You attack the target for Heavy Damage. Combo: If used after an ability with the Unarmed Strike keyword, this ability gains Full Pierce.

data.name: Elemental Bolt
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. The damage type is chosen at the type of casting and must be that of an element you have mastered. 

On damage, inflict an effect based on the damage type of this attack:

Arcane: The target loses 1 Mana
Fire: The target becomes Burning X, where X is your Focus x 3.
Water: The target becomes Soaked X, where X is your Focus, until they take lightning damage.
Lightning: The target becomes Static X, where X equals your Focus x 3.
Frost: The target becomes Slowed until the start of your next turn.
Earth: The target becomes afflicted with Sunder X, where X equals your Focus, for the next damage they take.
Wind: You push the target 10ft.
Holy: The target becomes inflicted with Illumination X, where X is your focus / 2.
Dark: The target becomes inflicted with Blinded X, where X is your focus, for their next attack.

data.name: Elemental Burst
data.description: You cause your attack to burst into the target causing them to take additional damage of that element equal to 2d4 + Focus.
data.requirement: Can be used after dealing elemental damage that does not contain the Full Pierce or Sure Hit keywords.

data.name: Elemental Convergence
data.description:
You may choose 1 element from Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Wind, Lightning or Earth. Until the end of the encounter, you are considered to have mastered that element.

You may swap this element once per turn for 1 Mana.

data.name: Elemental Mastery: Dark
data.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Dark

data.name: Elemental Mastery: Fire
data.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Fire

data.name: Elemental Mastery: Frost
data.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Frost

data.name: Elemental Mastery: Holy
data.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Holy

data.name: Elemental Mastery: Lightning
data.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Lightning.

data.name: Elemental Mastery: Wind
data.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Wind.

data.name: Elemental Strike
data.description:
You make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, your attack applies an additional effect based on one of your attack's damage type. (If you are able to have multiple damage types on the attack such as through Holy weapon, you may pick any of the effects).

Arcane: The target loses 1 mana. 
Fire: The target becomes Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3. 
Water: The target becomes Soaked X, where X equals your power/2 (rounded down), until they take Lightning damage.
Lightning: The target is afflicted with Static X, where X equals your Power x 3.
Frost: The target becomes slowed until the start of your next turn.
Earth: The target becomes Sundered X, where X equals your Power, until the next time they take damage.
Wind: You may push the target back 10ft. 
Holy: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Power + 3.
Dark: The target becomes Blinded 5 until after their next attack.

data.name: Elemental Sweep
data.description:
You may make a Light Attack against all enemies within range. On damage, your attack applies an additional effect based on one of your attack's damage type. (If you are able to have multiple damage types on the attack such as through Holy weapon, you may pick any of the effects).

Arcane: The target loses 1 mana.
Fire: The target becomes Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3.
Water: The target becomes Soaked X, where X equals your power/2 (rounded down), until they take Lightning damage.
Lightning: The target is afflicted with Static X, where X equals your Power x 3. 
Earth/Frost: The target becomes Slowed until the start of your next turn.
Wind: You may push the target back 10ft.
Holy: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Power+5.
Dark: The target becomes Blinded 5 until after their next attack.

data.name: Emergency Maneuvers
data.description: When you fail a check when operating an airship, you may use this to reroll the check. You must accept the new result and cannot reroll it again.

data.name: Emergency Recall
data.description: You give your summon 100 Damage Reduction against the attack. Afterwards, if it is still alive, it is immediately unsummoned.
data.requirement: Your summon from Summon Animal is the target of an attack.

data.name: Emergency Shield
data.description: The target gains temporary HP equal to 7 + Power.

data.name: Empower Mana Shield
data.description: You spend X mana to add X*8 to the value of your mana shield until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Empty Body
data.description: You may reroll the failed saving throw and must accept the new result.

data.name: En-dama
data.description:
You throw a smoke bomb on the ground within range that blocks line of sight in a 5ft radius (15x15 area total) of where it was thrown. Targets inside or within 5ft of the smoke can only see up to 5ft into or out of the smoke.

If you’re inside of it at the point it's thrown, you may immediately gain the Hiding state from anyone you have cover or concealment from.

The smoke lasts until the start of your next turn. When it ends, if you are inside your smoke, you may immediately move up to your speed and you are considered hidden up until you finish that movement. If you end your movement in cover, you keep being Hidden from people you have cover from.

data.name: Enduring Warmth
data.description: You can emit comforting heat within 30feet that counters the effects of most cold weather. You can activate or deactivate this heat every 1 second.

data.name: Energy Drain
data.description:
You deal Light full pierce dark damage to a willing ally other than yourself. This damage ignores damage resistance against dark damage (such as from gloom infusion or corvuskite armor), unless that DR is an universal type of DR.

You gain Haste, which gives you 2 AP for the rest of this turn. A target can only be affected by haste once per turn.

data.name: Envenom Weapon
data.description:
You enchant your weapon with a minor venom, making your attacks deal 1 additional full pierce Poison damage when you hit an enemy.

Lasts until the end of the encounter.

data.name: Escape Artist
data.description: You immediately escape the grapple by twisting and kicking. May be used by spending either AP or RP.

data.name: Eternal Mirane Cage
data.description: Instead of killing the target, they are reduced to negative their Max HP +1. The target is encased in Magical Ice for 10 years, rooted on the location and cannot be moved.  The Ice never melts despite temperature and can only be dispelled by Higher Order Magic (such as a Divine Arms), or by you. The Spell effect ends if you die. You can extend the duration of the Frost by 10 years for every 2 mana spent.
data.requirement: Use when an ally attack would kill a target and target is not an ally.

data.name: Eternal Vigil
data.description: While in statue mode and sleeping, you make perception checks as if you were awake.

data.name: Evasive Maneuver
data.description:
You Sidestep 5ft in any direction.

When used on your turn, you may spend 1 mana and 0 AP on this ability instead.

data.name: Evil Eye of Death
data.description:
You open your Mystic Eye, focus it on a single target and they instantly die.

Upkeep: 3 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack against a new target.

data.name: Evil Eye of Fear
data.description:
You open your Mystic Eye and inflict fear on everything in sight.

All targets in a 90 degree cone up to range must make a save against your potency or become Shaken until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: 1 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack.

data.name: Evil Eye of Lethargy
data.description:
You open your Mystic Eye and inflict lethargy on everything in sight.

All targets in a 90 degree cone up to range become Slowed until the start of your next turn, unless they spent 1 RP to resist the effect.

Upkeep: 1 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack.

data.name: Excavation Crash
data.description: Choose one adjacent location 5ft from the target. The target may immediately use a move action for 0 RP to move there if they wish, you cannot make an attack of opportunity during Excavation Crash. If the target does not move to the location, make a heavy attack against them.

data.name: Execute Heretic
data.description: You deal damage to the target equal to their max HP.

data.name: Expert Farmer
data.description:
Greater Infuse Qi
Keywords: Rapid
Description: 
You infuse one of the planted herbs with Qi, upgrading it from rare to mystic and adding 20 to its difficulty.

Bountiful Harvest II
Keywords: Rapid
Description: 
You bless one of the planted seeds that grants Food units or Alchemy materials. It grants 4 times that amount and you add 10 to its difficulty. Does not stack.

data.name: Expertise Study (Armorsmithing)
data.description:
You gain 5 Expertise Points in 2 different armorsmithing crafts. You also gain wielding proficiency in Heavy Armor or Greatshields.

In addition, you always gain the expertise bonus when crafting an armor for yourself. An armor crafted this way cannot be worn by other creatures and is effectively valued at 0 clim.

data.name: Expertise Study (Artificing)
data.description: You gain 5 expertise points in 3 different Artificing crafts.  You also gain one basic weapon proficiency or one specialized weapon proficiency of your choice.

data.name: Expertise Study (Blacksmithing)
data.description: You gain 5 Expertise Points in 3 different blacksmithing crafts. You also gain wielding proficiency in one smithing melee weapon of your choice. You may select specialized weapons with this.

data.name: Expertise Study (Carpentry)
data.description: You gain 5 Expertise Points in 3 different carpentry crafts.  You also gain wielding proficiency in one carpentry weapon of your choice (including specialized ones) or artifice chainsaws.

data.name: Explosive Advance
data.description: You immediately activate Horse Step Acceleration and it becomes active for the entire first round of combat.  Immediately make up to 1 AP of movement actions.

data.name: Explosive Ward
data.description: A ward that can be placed on a door or medium-sized container of some sort. If other than you knowingly tries to open the door or container in any way (whether normal opening, attacking it etc), the ward triggers creating a loud noise and dealing Heavy Fire Damage to all creatures in a 10ft radius around the container. All items inside the container (if any) also take this damage. Once triggered, the bounded field vanishes. Casting this takes 10 minutes of uninterrupted casting. You may at the time of casting choose a number of people equal to your Focus that can also open the container or door without triggering the ward. If not triggered, Explosive Ward lasts until you remove it. For each Explosive Ward you maintain your maximum mana is reduced by 2. This is considered a tier 2 ward.

data.name: Exposing Edge
data.description:
You sharpen your blades, enhancing the effects of your debuffs.

Upkeep: You may spend 1 AP or 1 mana to continue the effect.

data.name: Exposing Stab
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you may use your Devastating Strike against the target until the end of your turn as if the target had 0 RP.

data.name: Extending Spear
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against all targets in a line up to the range.

data.name: Extra Arms
data.description: Your next interact with object costs 1 less AP.

data.name: Fading Counter
data.description: When the enemy attacks you in melee, they instead attack an illusionary clone, missing you. You may then immediately attack the enemy with a basic Light Melee Attack. You may then move up to 5ft in any direction and this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

data.name: Fae Knight Style: Carapace
data.description:
One of your Fluttering Blades returns to you and interferes with the attack. You may take the dodge or block action against the attack. 

Your Fluttering Blade needs LoS to you or the target it is assisting.

This cancels Fluttering Blade on that weapon.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 RP or 1 mana to make it assist an ally within 30ft of the sword instead.
data.requirement: Heavy Spin Fluttering Blade Active. You or an ally is the target of an attack and your chosen Heavy Spin Fluttering Blade is not part of that attack.

data.name: Fae Knight Style: Devouring Locust
data.description: Your Fluttering Blade moves in a straight line up to 60ft. Make a light attack that affects every target that the Blade passes through.

data.name: Fae Knight Style: Gadfly
data.description:
Sends a Fluttering Blade to harass the target within 90ft of you, making a light attack against them. 

The Fluttering Blade then occupies the same space as the target and follows them throughout all movement, including teleportation. 

The Gadfly then Challenges the target. You can upgrade this attack of opportunity to a heavy attack for 1 RP or 1 Mana.

data.name: Fae Knight Style: Megasoma
data.description:
You direct a Heavy Spin Fluttering Blade at a target within 30ft of you, making a Heavy attack and cancelling Fluttering Blade on that weapon afterwards.

The chosen Blade must have Line of Sight to the chosen target.
data.requirement: Can only be used with Heavy Spin Fluttering Blades that have been active for at least 1 whole round.

data.name: Fae Knight Style: Oak Stance
data.description:
You enter Fae Knight Style: Oak Stance. Weapons with Fluttering Blade can move up to 20ft as a part of an attack. 

Your Fluttering Blade does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Fae Knight Style: Petal Swirl Flash

data.name: Fae Knight Style: Petal Swirl Flash
data.description:
You teleport to an enemy within range.

Make a melee Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise attack (2 AP) against that enemy. Afterwards, you regain the use of your Faerie Flash allowing you to use it again this encounter.

data.name: Fae Knight Style: Second Plague
data.description:
Your Fluttering Blade returns to your hand in the fastest possible path (typically a straight line), it avoids obstacles in the most direct way possible. Make a light attack that affects every target that the blade passes through. Deactivates Fluttering Blade when it returns to you.

Combo: If used after Devouring Locust, reduce the AP cost by 1.
data.requirement: An active Fluttering Blade within range and in Oak Stance. Must have a hand available to catch the weapon.

data.name: Fae Knight Style: Willow Stance
data.description:
You enter Fae Knight Style: Willow Stance. Increasing your Fluttering Blade Limit to 2. Shields can be used as Fluttering Blades while in Willow Stance. 

For 2 mana, all Fluttering Blades created in Willow Stance this turn can be enhanced with Heavy Spin, allowing them to be used for some Willow abilities but they no longer gain your agility as extra evasion.  Heavy Spin blades also deal 5d6 upgraded heavy attack damage, even if they were originally a one-handed weapon.

When directing your Heavy Spin blades to move, you may direct two blades for 1 AP instead of just 1 blade.

data.name: Faerie Eyes: Calling
data.description: You activate your Faerie Eyes, charming a target to move their Speed towards you. If your Focus is higher than the target’s the target moves up to its speed towards you. The target immediately stops their movement if they are going to take damage from further movement. Against Grunts, this attack always hits regardless of Focus, costs 0 mana, and the target will continue to move even if it will take damage.

data.name: Faerie Flash
data.description: You Teleport up to twice your Speed to an unoccupied space that you can see. Can only be used once per encounter.

data.name: Faerie Flash II
data.description:
You Teleport up to twice your Speed to an unoccupied space that you can see.

If you gain an effect that would let you regain the use of Faerie Flash and you use Faerie Flash II that turn, instead reduce the mana cost of this ability by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

data.name: Faerie Light Eyes:  Empty
data.description:
You lock eyes with an enemy, casting an illusion onto the target’s mind. Name an ability that the target had previously used in the current encounter. The target forgets the target ability, being unable to use it completely while the Illusion is in effect. This ability cannot target Secret Arts, Climax Arts or Esoteric Arts. Only one target may be under the effect of this illusion at a time. If the target is non-heroic and under the effect of Faerie Light Eyes: Hold Person, instead the target immediately is rendered insane permanently. An insane target takes no further combat actions.

If used on a grunt under the effects of Hold Person, they do not need to meet the normal requirements for this ability.

Does not work against Boss type enemies. Some abilities such as those granted by items, passives or racial abilities (such as flight) also cannot be removed by this ability (GM's discretion).

data.name: Faerie Light Eyes: Golden Illusion
data.description:
You copy the target’s ability that was forgotten and add it to your abilities until the end of the encounter. You must still fulfill all requirements to use this skill. This ability is generated from illusions and gains the keyword, Illusion. You can only have one Golden Illusion ability at a time.

If the target stops being affected by Empty, you lose your Golden Illusion ability.
data.requirement: A target is affected by Faerie Light Eyes: Empty.

data.name: Faerie Light Eyes: Hold Person
data.description: You gaze into the target’s eyes and stun them for 1 turn, reducing their AP and RP to 0. While stunned, the target can also not take any actions.
data.requirement: Target must be a grunt and have eyes.

data.name: Faerie Light Eyes: Time Dilation
data.description: Flooding your eyes with magic, you cast a self Illusion causes time slow down. You use the Dodge action with a Dodge bonus equal to 2X.
data.requirement: You are the target of a single-target attack.

data.name: Faithful Shield
data.description:
You may use Shelter once at 0 RP cost if the target is your Soulmate. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

Overcharge: You may spend 4 AP on this ability to instead gain 2 free uses of Shelter.

These free uses ignore the normal limitation of using an ability only once per turn.

data.name: Fan of Knives
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against all enemies in range. This is considered a Ranged Weapon Attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
data.requirement: Throwing Weapon, Set of Missiles or Thrown attack only.

data.name: Farming Basics
data.description:
Spiritual Ground
Cost: 1 Interlude Point
Description: 
You infuse the land with your spiritual energy, creating up to 10 plots of land suitable for farming. These plots of lands can grow food and herbs at an accelerated rate and allow the planting of tier 1 rare herbs.

All plots of land must be filled with seeds before they begin growing. 

After creating a spiritual ground, you may immediately use Sow Seeds in it for 0 IP.

You can only have 1 spiritual ground at the same time.

Sow Seeds
Cost: 1 Interlude Point
Description: 
You may plant seeds in plots of land. You may plant 1 set of seeds in each plot of land you can work.

Harvest
Cost: 1 Interlude Point
Description: 
You harvest the planted seeds or take care of the plants not ready to be harvested yet. Do a crafting session. Your crafting score is the total value of seeds you can harvest or take care of.

If your crafting score is not high enough to harvest or take care of all seeds you planted, you must give up on some of the seeds. Starting from the seed with the highest difficulty, you drop seeds until your total crafting score matches or exceeds the total difficulty of the seeds.

Infuse Qi
Keywords: Rapid
Description: 
You infuse one of the planted herbs with Qi, upgrading it from common to rare and adding 10 to its difficulty.

Bountiful Harvest
Keywords: Rapid
Description: 
You bless one of the planted seeds that grants Food units or Alchemy materials. It grants double that amount and you add 5 to its difficulty. Does not stack.

data.name: Fast Cartridge
data.description: You make two light attacks against the target.
data.requirement: Must be made with a pistol, musket or crossbow.

data.name: Fast Dimensional Equip
data.description:
You summon an item from your dimensional armory into your hand. You can also send a held weapon (not wielded or carried by another creature) under your full control to your Dimensional Armory and swap it with another from your Dimensional Armory.  

You may use 1 RP to activate this ability. If you do, the Mana cost is reduced by 1.

data.name: Fast Hands
data.description: You reduce the AP cost of your next Interact with object action this turn by 1.

data.name: Fast Runner
data.description: Your base movement speed is 25ft instead of 20ft.

data.name: Feeding Frenzy
data.description:
You may use this after reducing an enemy’s hit points to 0 or less.

You may immediately use your Vampire Bite ability for 0 RP against the enemy you downed.
data.requirement: Must be under the effects of Blood Frenzy.

data.name: Feign Death
data.description: The first time you enter the Downed state in an encounter, you may use Play Dead as a reaction for 0 RP. In addition, you gain a +10 bonus to playing dead.

data.name: Feigned Retreat
data.description:
All allies in a 15x15ft square within range may Sidestep up to their speed towards you. 

If they successfully left an enemy’s melee range and are not in an enemy’s melee range after moving, then the first time an enemy enters their melee range before the start of their next turn, they may make an Attack of Opportunity against that enemy.

data.name: Feint
data.description: You target an enemy. If the target is a Grunt or you have higher Agility than the target, then they cannot make an attack of opportunity against you until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Feinting Stab
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If they react to it in any way, you may cancel your attack on them and instead make it against a different enemy in range. Any RP spent by the first target is not refunded.

data.name: Felling Strike
data.description: Make a heavy attack against a target enemy that is no larger than large size category. On damage, sidestep to any unoccupied space next to the target, of the same elevation as the target, and knockback the target 10ft.

data.name: Field Medic
data.description: Medical and Surgery kits (including any upgraded versions) you carry have their burden reduced by 1, down to a minimum of 0.

data.name: Fiery Rebirth
data.description:
You regain HP until you are at 1 HP, stand up from prone and deal Light full pierce fire damage to all enemies within 5ft of you.

All buffs and debuffs on you are removed.

After using this ability, the mortal wound condition is removed from you and you cannot use Fiery Rebirth again for the rest of the arc.

data.name: Fight or Flight
data.description:
Fight: You immediately gain 2 AP that can be used on basic abilities, but lose 1 RP.

Flight: You immediately gain 1 RP, but recover 2 less AP on your next turn.

You regain the use of this ability after the Encounter Conclusion phase.

data.name: Fireball
data.description: You hurl a Fireball at a 15x15ft area, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in the area.

data.name: Fireball Barrage
data.description: You hurl three Fireballs at three separate 15x15ft areas, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in each area. Each unit can only be attacked once per use of this ability, even if hit by multiple fireballs.

data.name: Fireball II
data.description: You hurl a Fireball at a 15x15ft area, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in the area. On damage, they become Burning X where X equals your Power x 3 Overcharge: You may spend extra mana to increase the size of the area. Every mana spent increases the size by 5ft.

data.name: First Aid
data.description:
You grant an ally First Aid X, where X is the damage they took.

When an ally has First Aid applied by you, you may spend 1 AP while within 5ft of them to remove all First Aid and heal the target for your Focus up to the First Aid value.

data.name: First Response
data.description: If you have a Medical Kit, you may use your encounter conclusion to give the Second Wind encounter conclusion effect to someone else. You heal for an additional 1d6 (+3 from your Demonblood Regeneration if you have it) when doing this.

data.name: Fissure
data.description:
You slam the ground and create a 15ft wide fissure up to the target point. Those at the edges of the spell’s range may spend 1 RP to Sidestep 5ft out of the effect. All caught in the effect fall down 20ft into the fissure and take falling damage as normal.

The spell requires natural ground to be below the touching surface to function. It may work on the bottom floor of a house, but will fail if used higher up or in some dungeons.

data.name: Flame Infusion
data.description: You surround a willing target in searing flames, changing their typing to Fire II. As a Fire II type, they take half damage from Fire and Frost Damage or attacks with the Fire or Frost keywords unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Water Damage or attacks with the Water keyword. While the ward lasts, they also gain immunity to Burning. The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

data.name: Flame Shield
data.description: The attacker immediately takes Light Fire Damage.
data.requirement: An ally took damage from a melee attack.

data.name: Flame Wall
data.description: You create a wall of Fire that is 30ft long, 5ft wide and 30ft high. This wall must be a straight line. Anyone passing through the wall or starting their turn in it takes Heavy Fire Damage. The wall lasts for 10 minutes or until canceled. Those in the wall when it is casted, may spend 1 RP to sidestep out of the wall. A person can only take this damage once per round.

data.name: Flame Weapon
data.description: You touch one willing ally’s or your own weapon and enchant it with Fire. Until the end of the encounter, the weapon deals Fire Damage and grants a +1 Power Enchantment.

data.name: Flash Bomb
data.description: You throw a Flash Bomb at a point within range that explodes in an 25x25 area centered on that point. All targets within the area must save against Potency or become Dazed.

data.name: Flash Cut
data.description: You draw your katana and attack with such Speed it becomes impossible to perceive, making a Heavy Attack against the target, after which you resheathe the weapon. This ability does not break the Iai state.
data.requirement: Katana only, must be in Iai state.

name: Flash Star Style Secret Art: Twin Nova Pursuit

data.name: Flash Star Style Secret Art: Twin Nova Pursuit
data.description: You teleport to the target and then knock them 25ft in any horizontal direction.  You then teleport in a straight line to them again and make a Heavy attack.  If the attack is responded to with any RP action, knock them straight back 25ft again, teleport in a straight line to them and make another Heavy attack.
data.requirement: Light sword, Longsword, Katana, dueling weapon only.

data.name: Flash Star Style: Photon Line
data.description:
You sidestep exactly 25ft in a straight line in any direction and can move over gaps of terrain as long as you end on solid ground. You make a Light attack against all targets that are in your path.  If only one target is in your path, make a Heavy attack instead.

If you were flying at least 10ft above the ground when using this ability, you do not need to end on solid ground.
data.requirement: Can move 25ft in a straight line. Light sword, longsword, katana, dueling weapon only.

name: Flash Star Style: Starlight Crescent Reversal

data.name: Flash Star Style: Starlight Crescent Reversal
data.description: You take advantage of the slow windup of the enemy’s attack, countering with a Light attack of your own. You may still Dodge or Block the triggering attack after this counter.
data.requirement: You are targeted by a heavy attack. Light sword, Longsword, Katana, dueling weapon only.

data.name: Flash Star Style: Thunderbolt Slash
data.description:
You slash the target in a thunderbolt pattern, making a 3-hit attack.  Make 3 separate Light attacks against the target.  

Combo: If used immediately after Flash Star Style: Photon Line, mana cost reduced by 1.
data.requirement: Light sword, Longsword, Katana, dueling weapon only.

data.name: Flight
data.description:
You gain controlled Flight up to your speed. If you take damage while flying, your altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce your altitude to the point where you touch the ground, you become rooted and cannot fly again until the end of your next turn. If the attack that reduced your HP came from a flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude.

When you end any movement within 5ft of the ground, Flight ends (Causing you to become rooted if this was cause of damage taken).

data.name: Flower Squirt
data.description: You press your flower and make a Light attack against the target that deals Water damage. On damage they are Soaked for X, where X equals your Focus until the next time they take Lightning damage.

data.name: Flowing Kick
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target. Combo: If used after an unarmed attack misses, reduce the AP cost of this by 1.

data.name: Flowing Wind Strike
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target that deals additional damage equal to double your Windflow stacks. Afterwards, you lose all Windflow stacks.

Afterwards, you may Sidestep 5ft though this movement does not give a Windflow stack.
data.requirement: Must have moved at least 10ft before using this.

data.name: Flushing Shot
data.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. The target may choose to sidestep out of cover from your attack to automatically avoid the attack. Otherwise, the attack gains Sure Hit.
data.requirement: Target must be in Low or High cover.

data.name: Fluttering Blade
data.description:
You infuse a melee weapon within ability range that you are familiar with (belongs to you and was originally in your combat inventory at the start of the encounter, or has been in your dimensional storage for at least a day) with magic, causing it to float into the air that listens to your directions. You can have one Fluttering Blade at a time. 

When a Fluttering Blade weapon takes damage, it drops to the ground and becomes inert.

Fluttering Blade has a base evasion of 7+Your Agility.

You can direct your Fluttering Blade to move, it has a base movement speed of 30ft and does not provoke attacks of opportunity by moving. You can also direct your Fluttering Blade to attack within its attack range. It can make basic Heavy, Light and Precise attacks as well as special Fae Knight attacks. The blade is counted as its own entity for the purpose of attacking, though it uses your stats.

You need at least 1 hand free to direct a blade.

data.name: Fly
data.description:
You or the creature you touch gains Fly, which gives them controlled Flight, Hover and their movement speed is doubled while flying until the end of the encounter. If they take damage while flying (not hovering), their altitude drops by 20ft.

If this would reduce their altitude to the point where they touch the ground, they become rooted and cannot fly again until the end of their next turn. If the attack that reduced your HP came from an flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude.

data.name: Flyby Attack
data.description: You sidestep up to your speed. At any point during this movement, you may spend 1 AP to make a Light attack with a weapon or spend 2 AP to make a Heavy attack with a weapon. After this attack, you may change the direction in which you spend the rest of your movement.
data.requirement: Must be mounted on a flying mount.

data.name: Flying Kick
data.description: You may Sidestep next to the target within range and make a Light Attack against it. You gain Flight for this movement. Combo: Your Strike of Still Water has its AP cost reduced by 1.
data.requirement: Must have hit a target with Ki Blast in the previous action.

data.name: Focused Detonation
data.description: Make a gathering check against either Node or Lucky points. If this strike would max it out, you may instead leave it at 1 away from completion and you gain +1 Strike Dice

data.name: Focused Power
data.description: When you’re about to take the extra damage from Inexorable Shadow Stance, you may choose to maximize the damage instead of rolling. Affects both the self damage and the damage you deal with it.

data.name: Forager's Eye
data.description:
Initiate a sight and sound based search for hidden plants, fungi, creatures or living enemy units in a 30x30 area within range.  You become automatically aware of the targeted species of plants, fungi or creatures or you can choose to be aware of all hostile enemy units.  You must have line of sight to the target in order to spot them.  After revealing the target your Lifebeat Sense gains (if used immediately after):

Combo:  If used after Forager's Eye, the AP and mana cost of this is reduced by 1 and the target's location is known to you and your allies until the end of your next turn. This removes Hiding from them.
data.requirement: Can see or hear the target category.

data.name: Forest Walker
data.description: You ignore difficult terrain created by vines, foliage and similar natural phenomena.

data.name: Foretell
data.description:
You receive a vision of the near future. Roll a d20 and store that number. When you or your allies are going to roll that dice type, you can instead replace it with your dice roll, you then lose your Foretell dice. You can only have one Foretell dice at a time, casting Foretell again overwrites the previous dice. Foretel dice last until the end of your next turn.

After rolling, you may spend 1 mana to reroll the dice once. After doing this, you can't do so again for this use of the ability.

data.name: Forged Knowledge
data.description: Using your knowledge of weapons, you infuse the strongest point of your weapon with mana and then strike at the perfect angle dealing maximum weapon damage.  Maximize one damage dice for the attack.
data.requirement: Attack must be made with a weapon you crafted.

data.name: Forged Knowledge II
data.description: Your bond with the weapon allows you to infuse it with mana at a crucial point. Use when determining attack damage, maximize all weapon dice for that attack.
data.requirement: You or an ally attacked with a weapon or item you crafted.

data.name: Forgemaster Core Crafting
data.description:
Blacksmith’s Modification B
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an B-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon or Crafting mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

data.name: Forked Lightning
data.description: You make a Light Attack against two different targets who can be no further than 20ft apart, dealing Lightning Damage and on damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus x 2.

data.name: Forward Momentum
data.description: Until the start of your next turn, on damage of every melee attack you make, you may push the target back 5ft. You must then move 5ft towards that target (if possible to do safely) without provoking attacks of opportunity. This only works with attacks that target a single enemy.

data.name: Four Field System
data.description: Make a crafting check. Afterwards, whenever you use an ability for crafting that you haven’t used before in this crafting session, it gains a +2 bonus to the crafting points it gives.
data.requirement: Must be in a crafting session and costs 1 crafting dice.

data.name: Four Point Strike
data.description:
You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you apply Wave Palm II. 

Combo: If used after Two Point Strike or against a target afflicted with Wave Palm I, the mana cost is reduced by 2 and the AP cost by 1. If the target is afflicted with Wave Palm I, you apply Wave Palm III instead of Wave Palm II.

Wave Palm increases the mana cost of the afflicted target’s next action that uses mana by an amount equal to the amount of stacks applied. If the triggering attack makes the number of total stacks exceed the target's current mana, they lose mana equal to the amount of total stacks and take true damage equal to triple this amount. Wave Palm does not stack with itself, use only the higher value.

If the target has no mana, they immediately take true damage as if their stacks exceeded their current mana.

When the Wave Palm effect triggers, either by increasing the mana cost or by dealing the true damage, the Wave Palm effect is removed.

data.name: Freerunner
data.description: You do not incur difficult terrain penalties in Forest, Cities or Ruins.

data.name: Frost Coffin
data.description: You cast a Spell that flash freezes a target Grunt, killing them instantly and creates a two Glacial Wall cube stack at their location. These cubes have HP equal to 15 + Focus. These structures can function as cover. Ice wall segments take double damage from Fire Attacks.

data.name: Frost Driver
data.description:
You send ice spikes along the ground towards a single target, making a Heavy attack that deals Frost Damage. This cannot hit a target higher than 5ft above the ground. On hit, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.  If the target is already Slowed, they instead become Rooted, making them unable to move until the end of their next turn.

Combo: When used after Icicle Nail or White Thunder hits, reduce the mana cost to 0.

data.name: Full Bloom
data.description: You consume Regrowth on the target, removing the buff and healing the target immediately for twice its regular value.
data.requirement: Target ally must have Regrowth on them.

data.name: Full Dimensional Equip
data.description: You swap your armor, cloak and weapons currently wielded with a dimensional set.  The weapon and armor you had equipped as you used to this ability become a Dimensional Set, allowing you to switch back to it.

data.name: Full Power Swing
data.description: You may make a Heavy attack that does double heavy damage.

data.name: G. Shift
data.description:
You take 11 true damage, then choose to either lose 1 RP or reduce your AP by 1 for your first turn. 

You temporarily mutate your body, granting an effect similar to one of the following Alchemy Elixirs:  Rabbit, Reaper, Shark, Tunnel, Bull, Bear. This effect does not stack with their corresponding Elixir Effect. This effect cannot be dispelled and lasts until the end of the encounter.

data.name: Gale-Wind Aura
data.description: You project a Gale-Wind Aura around yourself that increases the movement speed of allies (excluding yourself) within 60ft of you by 20ft. An ally that starts their movement in the Aura, keeps the Speed increase for that move even if they leave the aura. Upkeep: You must spend 1 AP at the start of each turn or the aura fades.

data.name: Gene Activation
data.description:
You transmute yourself, consuming a gene. You transform,  granting yourself a single chimera racial ability that corresponds with the gene. 

You are transformed until the end of your next turn. Doing this consumes the gene from your DNA. You can deactivate the transformation for 0 RP.

You cannot obtain and use abilities that require an IP or EP to use through this ability.
data.requirement: Must have the required Gene in your gene inventory.

data.name: Genjutsu Kai
data.description: You focus your internal energies and dispel any Illusions affecting you or an ally within 5ft of you.
data.requirement: Target is under the effects of an Illusion.

data.name: Glacial Bastion
data.description:
You encase yourself in a Glacial Wall that fills your space until the start of your next turn, making you untargetable for attacks during the duration. This Glacial Wall has HP equal to 20 + Focus, any remaining damage is transferred to you (mitigated by your armor).  While encased, you can cast White Thunder on your encased Ice for 1 RP which removes Glacial Bastion. Other than White Thunder, you cannot take any other actions while under the effect of Glacial Bastion.   

This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

data.name: Glacial Wall
data.description: You create 4 * X connected ice structures that are 5ft x 5ft cubes that last for up to 24 hours. These cubes have HP equal to 20 + Focus. These structures can function as low cover. Ice Wall segments take double damage from Fire Attacks.

data.name: Gleaming Cut
data.description: You attack with blades of pure light making a light attack against the target, dealing Holy(Light) damage. On damage, inflict Illumination  X where X equals your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn.

data.name: Glide
data.description: You slow down your falling speed to 15ft per round and you are able to move horizontally as if normally moving. If you hit the ground while Glide is active, you do not take any falling damage and this effect ends.

data.name: Glittershards
data.description: Numerous sparkling arcane crystals swarm the area and block line of sight. Targets inside of or within 5ft of the Glittershards can only see up to 5ft into or out of Glittershards. Glittershards lasts for up to 10 minutes and you can only have 1 Glittershards active at a time. You can end this effect for 0 AP on your turn.

data.name: Gloom Infusion
data.description:
You surround a willing target in gloom and shadow, changing their typing to Dark II. As a Dark II type, they take half damage from Dark Damage or attacks with the Dark keywords, unless the attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Holy Damage or attacks with the Holy keyword. While the ward lasts, they also gain 60 feet Darkvision and a +4 bonus to saves against mind affecting effects. 

The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

data.name: Gnome Claws
data.description: You burrow into natural earth ground, granting Burrow, making you move underground at your normal speed.  While you are not attacking, you gain a +10/+20 bonus to your dodge except against other burrowed creatures. Using any action except movement or basic defenses cancels Gnome Claws.  Canceling Gnome Claws with a melee attack grants a +2 Accuracy Bonus to the attack.

data.name: God's Blessing
data.description: The AP cost of True Divine Release I is lowered by 4 and the mana cost upkeep is lowered to 0.

data.name: Good Fortune
data.description:
You always seem to find money in inexplicable ways.

At the end of an Interlude phase, you gain 500 Clim per Interlude Point spent during the phase.

data.name: Goring Charge
data.description:
You lower your head and charge in a direction with your horns. You move X times your speed in a straight line. If you move at least 15 feet, you make a Heavy attack against the first target in your path. They may sidestep this attack for 1 RP.

If a target sidesteps your attack, you continue charging for your maximum distance or until you hit an object. If you charge into another creature, you make a Heavy attack against them as well and the process continues. You do not provoke attacks of opportunity from creatures that sidestepped your attack for this movement.

If the object you charge into is destroyable, the GM may also ask you to make a Heavy attack against it.

These attacks are considered unarmed attacks that you are proficient in, even if you normally wouldn't be. It does not benefit from any sort of gauntlet bonuses.

data.name: Graceful Landing
data.description: You gain Graceful Landing until the start of your next turn, treating all fall distance as 50ft lower.

data.name: Graceful Service
data.description:
You assist a target character, giving them 1 additional encounter conclusion action.

This uses up your own encounter conclusion action.

data.name: Grand Theft Horse
data.description:
The target must make a save against your Potency or be immediately dismounted and knocked prone next to their mount. You may then spend 0 RP to immediately mount it.

Does not work against creatures that are considered a mount by themselves such as Dullahans or Centaurs.

data.name: Gravitational Ki
data.description: You target one unit and either push them away from you 5ft or pull them towards you 5ft. Cannot move a creature or object that’s bigger than 5ft and automatically fails against enemy heroic creatures.

data.name: Gravitational Push
data.description: You push the target 20ft or pull it 20ft towards you.

data.name: Gravity Crush
data.description: You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the target that deals Physical (Crushing) damage.

data.name: Greater Imbue Weapon
data.description: You may enchant your weapon as though you had used Imbue Weapon, but it also gains a +1 Power bonus in addition to the normal benefits. If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

data.name: Grindstone Echo
data.description: You make a crafting check. You may choose the dice result from a previous check this crafting session and use that as your roll value.

data.name: Grudge
data.description: You curse the attacker and make a Light attack that deals Dark(Curse) damage against them.
data.requirement: An enemy hits you with an attack.

data.name: Guard Dog
data.description:
You redirect the attack towards you instead of your ally and may take the Block action against it for 0 RP.

You may use this even if you’re also a target of the attack and both attacks will resolve against you. Your Block action works against both of these attacks.
data.requirement: An ally within range is the target of an attack.

data.name: Guided Aim
data.description: You gain a bonus to your next accuracy roll equal to the mana spent on this ability. If the attack is a Precise Attack, the bonus gained is doubled.

data.name: Half Restore
data.description: You heal your summoned animal for 11 + Power x 2 HP. It also removes 1 negative effect from it. If the amount healed exceeds the target’s maximum HP, any extra HP is converted into temporary HP.

data.name: Hammer and Nail
data.description: Make a light attack against the target with Sure Hit and Full Pierce.
data.requirement: An ally dealt damage to a target that didn't take a defense action.

data.name: Hardening Fist
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, you gain Hardening Fist, which gives +2 guard and +8 Block, but lose 4 evasion (including dodge) until the start of your next turn.

Combo: If used after Steadfast Earth Stance, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

data.name: Harvest Moon
data.description:
You call down a harvest moon over the area that shines in a 60ft radius around yourself. 

All allies in range may spend 2 Mana at the start of their turn to heal for 15 HP.

All enemies starting their turn in its range must make a Save against your potency or become slowed.

You may end this ability early by choosing to make a 0 AP heavy attack against an enemy slowed by this ability. This attack must be made with a Scythe. On killing blow of that attack, you recover 1 mana.

Upkeep: You must spend 1 mana at the start of your turn to continue this effect.

data.name: Haste
data.description: Grants the target Haste, granting them 2 AP for the rest of this turn.  A target can only be affected by haste once per turn.

data.name: Haunting Bark
data.description: You bark at an enemy forcing them to make a Save or become shaken until the end of their next turn. The third time in a combat you use this against the same target, they also take Light Full Pierce Lightning damage in addition to the shaken effect if they fail their save.

data.name: Headless
data.description: Critical hits rolled against you do not gain Half Pierce and do not automatically deal maximum damage.

data.name: Headwind
data.description:
You project an aura around you that hinders the movements of enemies. 

All enemies that start their movement within 30ft of you become slowed. If an enemy takes a Move basic action outside of your zone and spends more than 1 AP, they are still slowed after calculating each individual AP spent on the move.

Upkeep: 1 AP

data.name: Healing Seed
data.description:
The next time Regrowth naturally triggers on that ally and heals them, it also removes all stacks of a debuff on the target.

If the debuff has Persist, you pay this additional mana cost when the Regrowth triggers and not upon using this ability.
data.requirement: Target ally must have Regrowth on them.

data.name: Hearthlight
data.description: You can glow, emitting a comforting light within 30 feet. You can activate or deactivate this light every 1 second.

data.name: Heavenfall Descent
data.description:
You crash to the ground without taking falling damage and make a Light attack against all enemies within 5ft of you.

May target a point on the floor as long as it’s within 20ft of you horizontally.
data.requirement: Must be airborne and between 20ft and 120ft above the ground.

data.name: Heavenly Lightning Stance
data.description:
You enter the Heavenly Lightning Stance, a stance that lets you move with the unpredictability of the heavens. For your first movement of your turn, you may pass through enemies and your movement becomes a Sidestep.

If you have mastered Sky Talon Style, entering this stance also counts as your Wind Stance.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance or make an attack with anything other than a melee attack or an ability with the Unarmed Strike keyword.

data.name: Heavy Trample
data.description: When using Trample, you may use your Toughness for the damage roll instead of your mount’s power.

data.name: Helix Siphon
data.description:
When you make a melee attack against an enemy that is a Chimera, you copy some of their DNA, granting you a gene for any ability of their race.

This gene is temporary and only lasts until the end of combat. Alternatively, you can touch an ally Chimera or downed enemy and copy a single gene.
data.requirement: Melee attack deals damage against a known Chimera.

data.name: Hibernate
data.description: When you take the rest IP action, the temporary HP gained is doubled. When you rest during the night as a rest action, you recover an additional toughness HP.

data.name: Hidden Wards
data.description: You may choose to hide your Bounded Fields when casting them by making a Stealth check. The casted ward uses the result of your Stealth check. Hidden Bounded Fields cannot be seen with Sense Magic without a successful perception or insight check.

data.name: Hide in bush
data.description: You take the Hide action and are considered to be in cover for the purposes of remaining stealthed. This lasts until you take any action or speak.

data.name: Hide in Shadows
data.description:
You jump into a target’s shadow. If you were hidden before using this ability, you remain hidden inside the shadow. Else, the target or any other enemy may attack the shadow as if they were attacking you. If you take damage, you are forced out. While you’re inside the shadow, you travel with the target when it moves, including if it teleports, but cannot take actions other than exiting it.

You may exit the shadow willingly for 0 RP. When you exit it, if you were hidden, your next basic attack that turn against the target whose shadow you were hiding in gains Full Pierce.

data.name: High Power Shell
data.description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target. On damage, they are pushed back 10ft.

You are pushed back 5ft away from the target regardless of whether it hits or not.

data.name: Highly Sensitive to Magic
data.description: You may enter the Aetherie class without meeting its requirements and the cost for doing so is reduced by 100 exp.

data.name: Hit & Run
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, you may move up to your speed.

data.name: Hold the line
data.description: Your next Block action costs 0 RP. Until the start of your next turn, unless you use the Dodge action, you become Immovable.

data.name: Holy Declaration
data.description: You take the Block action against the attack. Afterwards, you challenge all enemies within 5ft of you until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Holy Light
data.description: You Heal the target for 8 + Power

data.name: Holy Orders
data.description:
You target an enemy unit within range, causing the target to become your Holy Order until the start of your next turn. 

While active, only your Holy Order may be chosen as the target for any offensive ability, or must be included as a target to use an offensive action. 

If you make an attack of opportunity against your Holy Order, or if they move away from you while in your melee range, you can Sidestep up to twice your Speed towards them for 0 RP after their movement finishes.

Can only be used on your turn before you use an offensive action.

data.name: Holy Shield
data.description:
Your gain Holy Shield, which gives your next Block action gains a +2 guard bonus (not doubled again). If you reduce the damage you take with your next Block action to 0, you gain 3 temporary HP.

Overcharge: You may spend up to 3 additional AP on this ability. Each extra AP spent increases the Guard bonus and temporary HP gained by 3.

data.name: HONK!
data.description: You place a clown nose on the target and honk it. The target must succeed at a Save or become challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Hopping Zombie
data.description: You gain +20 to any checks that involve jumping.

data.name: Horse Body
data.description:
You may carry an ally on your back without lowering your movement speed and your max Burden is increased by 2. However, you are considered a large creature. When attempting to move through 5ft wide spaces, it is considered difficult terrain for you and many humanoid buildings will struggle to accommodate you. You also suffer a -10 penalty on most finesse athletics checks, as well as a -10 penalty on climbing and swimming checks.

Picking up an ally takes 1 AP and they cannot take AP actions while on your back. You or they may spend 1 AP to dismount and act like normal.

data.name: Horse Step Acceleration
data.description: You gain Horse Step Acceleration until the start of your next turn, which increases movement speed by 30.  All of your movement is now Line Movement (You may only move in a straight line when making a movement action).

data.name: Horse Whistle
data.description: Your mount (the last mount you were riding on this arc) may sidestep up to its speed towards you and it gains Trample (as per the ability, if you have it) for this movement. If this movement moves your mount onto your square, you may mount it for 0 RP. If you were prone and mount your mount, you are no longer prone.

data.name: Hover
data.description: You can passively hover up to 5ft above the ground. While hovering, you are not an eligible target for abilities that require a target to be flying or airborne unless you'd meet those conditions normally.

data.name: Hug tight
data.description: You deal Light Damage to the target.

data.name: Human Adaptability
data.description:
As an errand action, you may refund an ability and choose to learn another ability. You cannot pick an ability that makes you ineligible for any of your prerequisites. Your new ability must cost the same as your unlearned one, or you must pay additional normal EXP to make up for the cost difference. If you choose to unlearn a class and learn a new one with this ability, you must spend IP for that new class as normal. Any previous IP spent on learning the class you unlearn is NOT refunded.

If you choose to refund primary stats, secondary stats or skill points and then level up the class again, you must put those points back in the same things you originally put them in.

Does not work on breakthroughs.

data.name: Hunting Wolf
data.description: You may move towards the target as if you had spent X AP on movement. Your movement speed is doubled for this movement.
data.requirement: The target enemy is below half HP.

data.name: Hydromancer
data.description: You start with the Hydromancer class unlocked and at level 2.

data.name: Hyphal Force
data.description:
Your spore symbiote surges the host’s muscles with temporary power. When the host of Spore Symbiote is making a melee attack, increase the damage by your Light Attack Damage. The extra damage dealt is Earth Damage.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
data.requirement: The host of your Spore Symbiote is making a melee attack.

data.name: Iai Strike
data.description: You draw your weapon and attack with lightning speed, making a Heavy Attack. You lose the Sheathed state afterwards.
data.requirement: Katana only. Must be in the Iai state.

data.name: Icicle Nail
data.description: You fire a shard of ice at a target unit, making a Light Attack that deals Frost Damage. On hit, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

data.name: Ignite
data.description: You may use this as a reaction after you deal Fire Damage to an enemy to set them on fire, causing them to become Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3. Overcharge: You may target additional enemies with this ability if you hit them with the same ability or attack. You may pay 1 mana per target beyond the first to also affect them with this ability.

data.name: Illuminating Flash
data.description: You select a point within range. All targets in a 15x15 area centered on the point must make a save against your Potency or be inflicted with Illumination X where X  your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn. They also become Blinded 5 for their next attack.

data.name: Imaginary Consumables
data.description:
You ‘draw’ an imaginary basic consumable alchemy item or minor item that can cost no more than 100c per mana spent on this ability and no more than 500c total. 

This consumable works like regular consumables would, but only you can use it, normal people can’t see it and it doesn’t work with abilities that require you to use real consumables like counter-potion.

Any items created with this ability only last until the end of the encounter, or for 5 minutes outside of one.

data.name: Imaginary Weapon
data.description:
You ‘draw’ an imaginary weapon or shield in which you are proficient. 

This weapon works exactly like a normal weapon would, but only you can wield it and normal people can't see it.

data.name: Imbue Weapon
data.description:
You enchant your melee weapon with an element you mastered. Your weapon now deals the chosen element’s damage instead of its normal damage.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

data.name: Improvised Defense
data.description: You grab a nearby item and use it as cover against the triggering attack while taking the Dodge or Block action. The type of item used determines whether it is light, heavy or full cover.
data.requirement: You become the target of an attack.

data.name: In The Zone
data.description: You add a crafting check to the item. This craft gains a +X bonus where X is equal to the amount of crafting dice spent this session.
data.requirement: Must be in a crafting session. Costs 1 Crafting Dice

data.name: Incendiary Ray
data.description: You may make a Light Attack that deals Fire damage against all targets in a 10ft wide line up to the range. On damage, inflict Burning X where X is your Power x 3.

data.name: Increased Reach
data.description: The range of the next Spell you cast is doubled. Only works on Spells that have a range listed in ft.

data.name: Independent Action
data.description:
Your animal summoned through the Summon Animal ability gains the ability to act independently. It acts at initiative 0, though you may still control its action. A summon with Independent Action starts with 2 AP and 1 RP and may use those as normal. If they have an ability that costs mana, then you still have to pay that mana cost.

While it is under the effects of Independent Action, you cannot command your summon through the use of your own AP.

A summon targeted by this ability takes up 2 slots towards the summon limit. If this would put you past your limit, you cannot use this ability.

data.name: Inexorable Shadow Stance
data.description:
You enter a stance that enhances your attacks at the cost of your own life. Whenever you hit an enemy with an unarmed attack, you may deal Light or Heavy true damage to yourself to increase the damage of the attack by the same amount. This may be done after reactions to the attack have been declared, though an enemy may still choose to react to it again or differently afterwards.

If used with an attack that hits more than 1 target, this extra damage only applies to one of the damage rolls.

You may do this effect twice per round. If an enemy dodges to make you miss and refund the effect, it still counts as one of your uses. When enhanced, these attacks gain the Augment keyword.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

data.name: Infernal Bastion
data.description: You surround yourself with flames and take the Block action against the attack. If you reduce damage of this attack to 0, inflict Burning X on the target where X is your focus x 3.
data.requirement: You are targeted by a melee attack.

data.name: Infinite Punches
data.description:
Your Manifestation makes X light attacks against the target.

If you spend at least 2 AP on this, it may make an additional light attack. If you do, this ability gains the Dual Wield keyword.

data.name: Inspired Finish
data.description: Make a crafting check. The dice is upgraded to 3d10 and you still add your crafting bonus to this. The crafting immediately ends after using this ability and you may not spend Crafting Points to add artisan bonuses, alloys or similar things.
data.requirement: This is your last crafting dice. Costs 1 Crafting Dice.

data.name: Inspiring Song
data.description:
All allies within range (including yourself) may add 1d4 to a single roll they make until the start of your next turn. They may choose to add this after seeing the roll.

Upkeep: At the start of your next turn and every turn thereafter, you may spend 1 AP to continue this performance, granting all allies within range the benefit once again.

data.name: Instinct
data.description:
The first time per encounter that you are attacked by a Stealth attack, that attack does not gain the Trick Attack benefit. If you become the target of an attack while you're surprised, you may still react to it and any special properties of an attack that require you to be unaware of the attack (such as Killshot) do not apply to it. 

In addition, when you are about to take an action that leads to grave harm or death (example: The enemy has an instant death ability), you can receive a premonition from the DM.

data.name: Intercept
data.description:
You move towards an ally, Sidestepping them 5ft in a direction of their choice and occupying their square. The triggering attack is made against you and you automatically take the Block action against it.

Mounted move rules apply to your movement for this action.
data.requirement: Must be mounted and an ally is the target of an attack.

data.name: Into the Fray
data.description: You may move up to twice your movement speed. You must end this movement in range to make a melee attack against an enemy. Can only be used on your turn.

data.name: Invisible Wall
data.description: You create an invisible 5ft wide and high wall within range. It gives Low Cover, but it counts as High Cover against the first ranged attacks the wall gives cover from.

data.name: Judgement Shot
data.description:
You make a Light attack against the target.

Afterwards, an ally other than you within 30ft of you may make a Light attack against the target. They may spend 1 RP to make this a Heavy or Precise attack instead.

data.name: Jump
data.description: You leap up to 30ft into the air and then Sidestep up to twice your Speed. You may use Skydive at any point during this movement.

data.name: Jump Back
data.description: You Jump Back to your previous location. This movement does not provoke any attacks of opportunity.
data.requirement: Previous action had the jump keyword.

data.name: Just a hug
data.description:
You coil and grapple a non-heroic enemy that is not larger than you, rooting both of you and rendering the target incapable of any attacks.  You automatically guard against any attacks made towards the target as if using Block.  You can also use this on a willing ally target.

The target may spend 1 Ap or 1 RP to attempt to escape, granting them escape power equal to their power.  Further escape attempts continue to add escape power.  When the escape power is equal to 8, then the target successfully escapes. Unlike normal grapples, this does not take upkeep and you may end this effect at any time for 0 RP.

data.name: Justice Blade
data.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.
data.requirement: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

data.name: Kage Bunshin: Kyomei
data.description: Your clone assists in the preparation of your next Ninjutsu, reducing the AP cost of it by 1.
data.requirement: You must have a Bunshin clone active and within range.

data.name: Kage Shuriken no Jutsu
data.description: You attack by throwing two weapons at the target, one hidden in the shadow of the other. Both of these are considered Light Attacks. If you fail your Accuracy roll on the first one, the second gains Sure Hit.
data.requirement: Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

data.name: Kawarimi no Jutsu
data.description: The triggering attack automatically misses and you may move up to your Speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. You then gain the Hiding state from anyone you have cover or concealment from.

data.name: Ki Blast
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals Arcane damage.

data.name: Ki Blast II
data.description: You may make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) Attack against the target. This attack deals Arcane Damage.

data.name: Ki Burst
data.description:
Your attack deals an extra X damage.

If used with a basic attack or double punch, deal 2X extra damage instead up to a maximum of +10 damage. Only affects 1 damage roll even if an attack makes multiple attacks.
data.requirement: Can be used after damaging a single opponent with an Unarmed Strike attack.

data.name: Ki Circulation
data.description: You cycle the Ki inside your body and purge it from negative energy. You remove Bleeding, Shaken, Unbalanced or any Poison effect from yourself.

data.name: Ki Recovery
data.description: You spend your Encounter Conclusion action to regain 2 mana.

data.name: Ki Sense
data.description: You send out your Ki and become aware of any creatures without presence concealment within 40ft of you, giving you a rough idea of their location. This does not remove Hiding from them, but their attacks against you do not gain Trick Attack or any other stealth or surprise bonuses until the start of your next turn.

data.name: Kibaku Fuda Shuriken
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack by throwing a weapon with an explosive tag attached at a target. Regardless of whether it hits, the target and others within 5ft of the target must then make a save against Potency or take Light Fire Damage.
data.requirement: Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

data.name: Killshot
data.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals double Heavy Damage instead.

If fired in the first round of combat while all enemies are unaware of you, the target has to spend an additional RP to react to your attack. This stacks with the Trick Attack keyword, but is ineffective against abilities that negate surprise or stealth attacks such as Instinct.

data.name: Kiri-tsuke
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you regain the Iai state.

data.name: Kiri-tsuke II
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you regain the Iai state. Combo: If used after Iai Strike, the AP cost is reduced by 1.

data.name: Kneel
data.description: The target must make a Save or fall prone.

data.name: Knockback Shot
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target is pushed back 20ft.

data.name: Knockout Punch
data.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage if the enemy is a Grunt, they immediately drop to 0 HP and fall unconscious.

data.name: Kugeki-zan
data.description: You make a Light attack against the target.

data.name: Last Rites
data.description: You deal +1 damage to undead creatures. This is increased to a +2 bonus on Heavy attacks.

data.name: Last Stand
data.description: Until the start of your next turn, you may use the Block action for 0 RP and you gain additional Guard equal to the mana spent on this ability. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again in this encounter.

data.name: Lay on Hands
data.description: You Heal the target for 4 + Power. Overcharge: You may spend an additional mana to remove a negative effect from the target. Injuries and Mortal Wounds cannot be removed with this.

data.name: Leashing
data.description: You teleport your summoned animal to an empty square within 5ft of you.

data.name: Leg Sweep
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, the target falls Prone.

data.name: Lengthened Incantation
data.description:
You lengthen the time it takes to cast your next Spell to empower it. You may add 2 AP to the cost of your next spell with the Spell gaining additional Light Damage on it. If you cannot pay this AP cost this turn, the Spell also gains the Setup keyword.

If the Spell has multiple attack rolls or different damage rolls, this bonus only applies to one of them.

However, if the spell is a Scattering AoE spell then the bonus damage applies to all targets of that spell. If that Scattering spell hits a target more than once it only applies to one damage roll. If the spell lasts for multiple turns, it only applies to the initial casting.

data.name: Lifebeat Sense
data.description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of the target until the end of combat.  (The DM should enable health bars for the unit, or you can ask for an approximate percentage). In addition, the target is afflicted by Expose 1, reducing the target’s crit threshold by 1. (20 to crit becomes 19.) Expose is removed once the target is critically hit (regardless of if they defend or not)

data.name: Lifesense
data.description:
You know the direction your Soulmate is in and if you’re within 300 feet of them, you know their exact location.

You also know their current HP, Mana and RP.

data.name: Light Work
data.description: Only usable as the first crafting action. All material costs are doubled and all produced items are doubled. You may only use basic crafting actions for the rest of the craft. Make a crafting attempt.

data.name: Light's Care
data.description: At the end of combat you may use 1 Encounter Conclusion action to heal a single target for 11 + Power x 2 and grant them First Aid. First Aid: The target can expend an Encounter Conclusion Action to prevent one injury to themself.

data.name: Lightning Lariat
data.description:
You gather lightning energy and move up to your speed in a direct line and make a Heavy attack against a target. If you moved more than 60ft before making the attack, your attack gains the Trick Attack keyword.

Overcharge: You may spend X mana to move an additional 2 x X times your speed. 

Combo: If used after Heavenly Lightning Stance or Secret Art: Lightning Release, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

data.name: Lightning Rod
data.description: You gain Damage Reduction 100 Lightning for the triggering attack. If you reduce damage in any way from this ability and the attacker isn't you, you gain a Power Bonus on your next Lightning Elemental Attack equal to the attacker’s Power.

data.name: Lightning Weapon Expert
data.description: You start with the Flash Star Blade Style class unlocked and at level 1.

data.name: Line of Death
data.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. Overcharge: You may spend 1 additional mana and AP to make another Light Attack against the same target.

data.name: Living Lightning
data.description: You turn into a spark of lightning as you move. For this movement action, you deal Light Lightning damage to all creatures you pass through.
data.requirement: Not mounted and must move entirely in a straight line.

data.name: Localized Collapse
data.description:
You target a 15x15ft square. All in the area take damage equal to your Focus / 2. If a creature occupies multiple squares in your target square, they take damage for each square they occupy.

A creature caught in it may spend 1 RP to avoid the effect.

data.name: Lone Wolf Stance
data.description:
You enter a stance in which you declare you fight alone. This lasts until the end of the encounter or until you are Downed.

While in this stance, you cannot become the target of allied abilities, except AoE ones that also hit enemies at the same time, nor any other abilities that buff allies such as aura's. At the same time, you cannot use abilities on allies either except damaging ones that also work on enemies (including aura type abilities again). Abilities or effects that require a willing ally or you to be a willing ally for someone also do not work.

However, you may use Aid abilities on yourself.

data.name: Long Toss
